defects.reproduction: The grep above, plus: at /#/palettes click ⋯ → Export → JSON and inspect the downloaded file — it carries `export.ts`'s ad-hoc shape, not the Appendix-W51 canonical `oklch(<l> <c> <h> / <a>)` spelling from `export/canonical.ts:29`.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `demo/palettes/export.ts` and `demo/palettes/usePaletteExport.ts`; rename `demo/palettes/export/serializers.ts` to `index.ts`; type the menu's five items with `ExportFormat` from `export/types.ts` so the format vocabulary feeds directly into L-1's discriminated union. A deletion, not a build — and it moves 914 lines of contract code from test-only to shipping.

defects.defect: The three named import-boundary invariants that were supposed to police this region (G-DEMO-1, G-DEMO-3a, G-DEMO-3b) are dead: they are wired to file globs and a specifier alias that no longer exist. The subject file sits in a region with zero import-boundary enforcement.
defects.evidence: `npx eslint --print-config demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCard/PaletteCardMenu.vue` → `no-restricted-imports: null`. The rules' globs are `demo/@/components/**`, `demo/@/lib/**`, `demo/@/composables/**` (eslint.config.js:235-238, 275-276) and `ls -d demo/@` → 'No such file or directory'. Where the rule does still attach (`npx eslint --print-config demo/color-picker/App.vue`) it bans `@components/custom/palette-browser/**/*.vue`, and `grep -rn 'from "@components' demo src | wc -l` → 0; `@components` is not an alias in vite.config.ts or any tsconfig. W43/RF-15 retired the demo `@…` aliases (documented at vite.config.ts:68-74) and moved the tree to physical homes; the lint was not moved with it.
defects.mechanism: Enforcement expressed against PATHS rather than against the module graph, so a restructure silently detaches it with no failing test. Contrast inv-K-1 (eslint.config.js:204-217), which survived because its glob `src/**` did not move — the pattern that lived is the one keyed to a stable directory.
defects.reproduction: The two `--print-config` invocations above, pasted verbatim in the report.
defects.proposedCure: Express boundaries structurally with `eslint-plugin-boundaries` (or `import/no-restricted-paths`) keyed on ELEMENT TYPES declared per directory (shell / platform / feature / shared / ui). That cannot silently detach, because an unclassified directory is itself an error. Minimum viable interim: a CI assertion that every `files:` glob in eslint.config.js matches at least one file.

defects.defect: `demo/ui/` is 19 directories of one-line pass-through barrels over @mkbabb/glass-ui — a legacy alias layer with no encapsulation and no policy, reached from this component through four `..` segments.
defects.evidence: `cd demo/ui && for d in */; do echo "$d $(wc -l < $d/index.ts) <- $(grep -o 'from \"[^\"]*\"' $d/index.ts)"; done` → 19 dirs, 18 of them 1 line, all bare re-exports; 18 reach the glass-ui ROOT `@mkbabb/glass-ui`, `input/` alone reaches the `/forms` subpath. `demo/ui/dropdown-menu/index.ts` is a single line re-exporting the 14 symbols `PaletteCardMenu.vue:180-190` imports, which glass-ui already publishes as a dedicated `./dropdown-menu` subpath key. Reach path: `PaletteCardMenu.vue:190` `from "../../../../ui/dropdown-menu"`.
defects.mechanism: shadcn-vue sediment: the ~178 local implementations were replaced by glass-ui re-exports but the directories and specifiers were never revisited, so 4 dropdown call sites (and ~90 sites overall) inherited the widest possible reach. Violates edict 2 (aliases/dual paths), edict 3 (contrivance — 19 dirs with zero behaviour), and edict 4 in spirit (the design-system boundary should be the package boundary).
defects.reproduction: The loop above; plus `grep -rn "ui/dropdown-menu" demo` → 4 call sites (ProfileSection.vue:12, MobileMenuDropdown.vue:10, PaletteCardMenu.vue:190, UserSortMenu.vue:48).
defects.proposedCure: Delete `demo/ui/` entirely and rewrite the call sites to glass-ui subpaths — `import { … } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui/dropdown-menu"`. Nineteen modules disappear and edict 4 becomes structurally true. Justify on structure, not bytes (see C-2).

defects.defect: `isOwned` is a domain predicate with no home: it is computed in exactly one place in the repository, as an inline template expression, and omitted at the other four PaletteCard consumers — where `isOwned?: boolean | undefined` makes omission legal and indistinguishable from 'not owned'.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn "isOwned|is-owned|userSlug ===" demo` → the only derivation is `BrowsePane.vue:99` `:is-owned="palette.userSlug === pm.userSlug.value"`; `PaletteCard.vue:87` is a pass-through; the menu reads it at five gates (`:49, :74, :84, :134, :144`). `AdminUsersPanel.vue:140-151` renders REMOTE palettes with `is-admin` but no `is-owned` → `undefined` → falsy → the admin sees 'Report' (`:144`, `!isOwned`) and cannot Rename (`:74`), Edit Tags (`:84`) or Delete (`:134`).
defects.mechanism: `getPaletteKind(palette)` has a home (`demo/palettes/utils.ts:22`); its sibling question 'is this palette mine' was written inline once and thereafter travelled as an optional prop. Optionality converts a missing input into a wrong answer.
defects.reproduction: Static and complete: the grep plus AdminUsersPanel.vue:140-151. The behavioural consequence (an admin seeing Report on their own palette) is a HYPOTHESIS — verifying it needs an authenticated admin session with an owned palette, which the local stack cannot serve while the API is unreachable.
defects.proposedCure: `demo/palettes/utils.ts` gains `export function isOwnedBy(p: Palette, userSlug: string | null): boolean` beside `getPaletteKind`. Better, pass `userSlug` (which every consumer already has via the session) rather than a pre-computed boolean, so omission is a type error rather than a silent false. Under L-1's descriptor cure the prop disappears entirely — ownership becomes a predicate the filter evaluates once.

defects.defect: Interactive-content nesting: the card's menu trigger `<button>` renders inside a consumer's native `<button>`, producing a DOM tree HTML forbids. The library offers no thumbnail-shaped surface, so a consumer that wants one wraps the instrument.
defects.evidence: Measured at /#/mix palettes mode: `NESTED button-in-button: 2 [{"outerAria":"Select palette Probe Alpha","inner":"Palette menu"},{"outerAria":"Select palette Probe Beta","inner":"Palette menu"}]`. Source: `MixSourceSelector.vue:246-268` wraps `<PaletteCard>` in `<button type="button" :aria-pressed>`; `PaletteCard.vue:96-104` renders the glass-ui `<Button icon-only aria-label="Palette menu">`, a real `<button>` (node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/button-Bu9F4uU6.js). HTML Living Standard §4.10.6: the `button` content model is 'Phrasing content, but there must be no interactive content descendant.'
defects.mechanism: Vue builds the DOM through createElement/appendChild, which — unlike the HTML parser — does not enforce content models, so the forbidden tree survives to runtime silently and is what AT consumes. Structurally: one component is being asked to be both an instrument (Browse/Palettes/Admin) and a thumbnail (Mix source/Extract preview), and the 17-emit optional bag is what let it pretend to be both.
defects.reproduction: `node probe-L3-mix-relay.mjs` — the nesting query is `document.querySelectorAll("button button")`, returning 2 rows.
defects.proposedCure: Split the component: `PaletteCard` (takes an `actions` handler map) and `PaletteCardTile` (inert — no menu, no emits), sharing the already-separate `PaletteColorStrip` and `PaletteCardMeta`. No new abstraction is invented; an existing one is stopped from overreaching. MixSourceSelector's wrapper `<button>` then deletes, or the card grows a first-class `selectable`/`@select` affordance so selection lives with the `role="article"` element where `aria-selected` belongs.

defects.defect: Transport DI at leaf altitude: a pure presentational menu calls `useApiClient()`, which throws without a provider, making the component unmountable in isolation — no unit test, no visual-state harness.
defects.evidence: `PaletteCardMenu.vue:216` `const { availability } = useApiClient();` and `demo/platform/transport/useApiClient.ts:56-62` `if (!client) throw new Error("useApiClient() requires an API_CLIENT_KEY provider …")`. Every other input to the component is a prop (`:206-212`). It also instantiates per card: a 50-row browse grid performs 50 `inject` + 50 `computed` over one shared Ref.
defects.mechanism: Altitude, not direction — feature → platform is correctly downward. The defect is a LEAF asking a global question, which is why the states this component gets wrong (L-17) have never been caught by a test and why the visual matrix has no row for it.
defects.reproduction: Static: mounting `PaletteCardMenu` with `@vue/test-utils` and no `provideApiClient()` above it throws at setup. No such test exists — `grep -rln PaletteCard demo/test test e2e` returns only e2e specs, none of which mount this component in isolation.
defects.proposedCure: Fold into L-1 + L-17: `availableActions(palette, viewer, availability)` takes the latch as an argument and returns actions already carrying `disabled` + `annotation`. The menu becomes 100% props-driven and trivially harnessable; exactly one `useApiClient()` call remains, at the pane.

defects.defect: The remote/local discriminator is spelled two ways inside this one 228-line file: eight items gate on `paletteKind`, the Versions row re-derives `!palette.isLocal`.
defects.evidence: `PaletteCardMenu.vue:94` `v-if="!palette.isLocal && (palette.versionCount ?? 0) > 1"` vs `paletteKind` at `:16, :28, :49, :64, :74, :84, :134, :144`. `demo/palettes/utils.ts:22` DEFINES them equal: `if (!palette.isLocal) return "remote";`. Note also that `paletteKind` is itself derived state passed as a prop — `PaletteCard.vue:225` computes it from the same `palette` object the menu already receives.
defects.mechanism: Two spellings of one predicate 42 lines apart in a file whose entire job is to branch on that predicate. Any future refinement of `getPaletteKind` (a fourth kind, a server-side `isLocal` change) silently skips the Versions row.
defects.reproduction: Static — `:94` vs `utils.ts:22-30`. No live divergence today; labelled a latent defect.
defects.proposedCure: Drop the `paletteKind` prop entirely — it is a pure function of `palette`, which the component already has, so `const kind = computed(() => getPaletteKind(palette))` inside the menu removes both the prop-drill and the second spelling. Under L-1's descriptor cure it becomes a `kinds: ["remote"]` field and the question cannot recur.

defects.defect: Fourth home for 'is this palette public', with the OPPOSITE answer to the API's own canonical predicate on the `unlisted` state — in a file that also ignores the authoritative `published` boolean the wire already ships.
defects.evidence: `PaletteCardMenu.vue:222` `isPublic = palette.visibility !== "private"` (unlisted → public) vs `api/src/modules/palette/service/visibility.ts:31-38` `isActivePublic` = `visibility === "public" && !deletedAt` (unlisted → NOT public) vs `api/src/modules/palette/format.ts:86` `published: rest.visibility === "public"` vs `demo/palettes/types.ts:44-47` which types `published?: boolean` on the client row. `isActivePublic`'s own header states its purpose: 'Shared … so those surfaces cannot drift apart.' The demo surface drifted, and also ignores `deletedAt`.
defects.mechanism: A domain predicate re-derived in a template script block instead of consumed from its declared home — the same union-collapse mechanism as L-17, here testing one member of a 3-member union.
defects.reproduction: NONE — HYPOTHESIS. I closed the reachability question in both directions: no client-reachable write path produces `unlisted`. `crud.ts:97` and `forks.ts:76` create at "public"; the only visibility route takes `target: Extract<PaletteVisibility, "public" | "private">` (visibility.ts:60-64). The 3-state enum has a dead middle at both ends of the wire. The divergence is a live TYPE-LIE (the type declares a state the system cannot produce, and two modules disagree on its meaning) but not a live behavioural bug.
defects.proposedCure: Consume the wire's `published` field and delete the local derivation; if a richer predicate is wanted, name it once in `demo/palettes/utils.ts` beside `getPaletteKind` as `isPubliclyVisible(p) => p.visibility === "public"`. Then either the UI gains the third state or the API stops declaring it — the one outcome not available is the current one, where the type says three and the instrument says two.

defects.defect: Dead dispatch entry surviving in the parent's action map, invisible to tsc because the key space is `string`.
defects.evidence: `grep -rn copyAll demo src e2e` → exactly one occurrence repo-wide: `PaletteCard.vue:294` `copyAll: () => void writeClipboard(props.palette.colors.map((c) => c.css).join(", ")),`. No menu item emits `copyAll`.
defects.mechanism: A menu item was removed while its dispatch entry survived. `Record<string, () => void>` cannot express 'these are the only valid keys', so an orphaned entry is legal code.
defects.reproduction: The grep above.
defects.proposedCure: Subsumed by L-1: typing the emit as a closed discriminated union makes `copyAll` a compile error. Note this is NECESSARY BUT INSUFFICIENT — typing the emit catches a dead handler; it does NOT catch an unwired `delete`. Only the handler-map inversion catches both.

defects.defect: The visual-audit corpus contributes zero evidence about this component; the matrix's silence must not be read as a clean bill.
defects.evidence: Read `docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/browse.png` — renders 'The commons is unreachable. / Failed to load palettes' and 'No saved palettes yet.' `REPORT.md:120-121` records bodyText 237/280 chars for /#/palettes and /#/browse across all four matrices, consistent with empty states. The `namelessButtons — /#/palettes: 1` row (REPORT.md:98) is NOT this component: its trigger carries `aria-label="Palette menu"` (PaletteCard.vue:100).

defects.proposedCure: Seed `localStorage["color-palettes"]` in the capture harness (`capture.mjs`) via `addInitScript` before navigation — the same two-line technique both my probes use — so palette-bearing surfaces render in the matrix. Without it the component band's 88-component sweep has a blind spot exactly where the card cluster lives.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt (pass 3) on demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCard/PaletteCardMenu.vue
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]` (1M-context variant). Declared at spawn, not inherited.
result.strongestDefect: C2-1 remains strongest overall and was independently re-reproduced this pass (Delete on /#/mix: store 5 -> 5, cards 5 -> 5, menus 0; matched control on /#/palettes in the same run: 5 -> 4). Of the six NEW pass-3 rows, C3-1 is strongest: the "K-INV5 small-caps register" that this file's own comments name three times has never rendered a single small capital — `font-variant: small-caps` is cancelled by the sibling `text-mono-caption` utility's `text-transform: uppercase`. Measured on the shipped span: 55.266px with the declaration, 55.266px without it, 39.094px if the uppercase utility is removed. A ratified, named, thrice-commented design decision that no gate in the repo can see, and that would stay green if deleted.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so no negative is claimed for the component as a whole. The following sub-claims WERE probed and found sound this pass, and should not be re-litigated: (1) trigger as-child ARIA forwarding is correct — ::A1_triggerAttrs shows BUTTON with aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded="true", aria-controls, data-state, 36x36; (2) disabled items cannot be keyboard-activated despite the @click wiring — reka MenuItem.js keydown guards `if (_ctx.disabled ...) return` before `event.currentTarget?.click()` and handleSelect guards `!props.disabled`; (3) no double-fire — MenuItem.js onPointerup synthesises a click only `if (!isPointerDownRef.value)`; (4) the item list is never empty for any of the six reachable kind x isOwned x isAdmin combinations; (5) grids key by identity, not index (BrowsePane.vue:98 :key="palette.slug", PalettesPane.vue:84 :key="palette.id") so no open-menu identity migration; (6) isOwned is NOT true-for-all when logged out — useUserAuth.ts:31,61 makes userSlug `null`, palette.userSlug `undefined`, and `undefined === null` is false; (7) opening the menu inside /#/mix's selection button does not flip selection (::E1 pressedBefore == pressedAfterOpen); (8) neither surface causes horizontal page overflow on mobile (docScrollW 390 == innerW 390); (9) tap targets pass — items 178x44 / 287x44, trigger 36x36; (10) edict 8 verbatimModuleSyntax passes (:177/:178 both `import type`); (11) edict 1 passes — 228 lines, two computeds, no local state; (12) none of the six known local hazards are present; (13) zero page errors across all five pass-3 probe runs.

defects.defect: 22 menu-item instances across 3 of 5 host sites are wired to nothing: the menu emits an untyped `action: string`, PaletteCard converts it to a second emit and swallows misses (`const fn = actions[action]; if (!fn) return`), and whether an item does anything is decided by a @-binding in a host file neither component can see. MixSourceSelector binds nothing at all, so `Delete` silently does nothing.
defects.evidence: Re-reproduced independently this pass, evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-e.mjs: `::E2_deleteOnMix {storeBefore:5, storeAfter:5, cards:5, menus:0}` vs matched control in the same run `::E3_deleteOnPalettes_CONTROL {storeBefore:5, storeAfter:4, cards:4}`. Source: PaletteCardMenu.vue:224-227; PaletteCard.vue:315-316; demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:266-269 binds no handlers.
defects.mechanism: stringly-typed cross-component action contract with a silent swallow at the dispatch site; correctness is a property of files the component never sees, checked by nothing
defects.reproduction: Seed 5 local palettes in localStorage key `color-palettes`; open http://localhost:9000/#/mix, switch to Palettes mode, click the `...` trigger on any card, click `Delete`. Store and card count are unchanged and the menu closes as if it worked. Repeat on /#/palettes: 5 -> 4.
defects.proposedCure: Two halves. (a) Make the action set a `PaletteCardAction` union and the dispatch table `Record<PaletteCardAction, () => void>`, deleting `if (!fn) return` — that makes a miss a compile error. (b) The real transposition: the menu must not offer an item its host cannot service. Derive the item list from a capability set the host declares (or from the handlers it provides), so a selection card renders with no menu at all rather than a menu of eight lies.

defects.defect: `@click.prevent` on DropdownMenuSubTrigger (:108) kills the whole Export submenu on pointer input. reka's MenuSubTrigger onClick bails on `event.defaultPrevented`, and its pointermove path early-returns for pointerType 'touch', so touch has only the dead click path.
defects.evidence: Two NEW pointer reproductions this pass. Desktop synthetic mouse click with the hover timer cleared (pcm-p3-a.mjs): `::A6_clickOnSubTrigger {menusBefore:1, menusAfter:1, ariaExpanded:"false", dataState:"closed"}`. Real iPhone-14 tap() (pcm-p3-c.mjs): `::C3_touchTapOnExport {menusBefore:1, menusAfter:1, subState:{ariaExpanded:"false", dataState:"closed", hasChevronAffordance:true, childSvgCount:2}}`. Source: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Menu/MenuSubTrigger.js onClick `if (props.disabled || event.defaultPrevented) return;`.
defects.mechanism: a template event modifier applied to a primitive whose activation guard reads defaultPrevented — the modifier suppresses no browser default and disables the primitive's only pointer path
defects.reproduction: iPhone 14 emulation (hasTouch), /#/palettes, tap the `...` trigger, tap `Export`. Submenu stays closed, aria-expanded stays false. The item still renders a chevron affordance (childSvgCount 2) promising a submenu.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the modifier — removal is a strict simplification, since 'don't close the menu' is already the sub-trigger's behaviour. But pair it with C3-4: opening the submenu on a phone ships the occlusion defect. The single cure for both is to retire the <DropdownMenuSub> family and render Export as an inline group in the parent menu; it is the demo's only submenu (grep DropdownMenuSubTrigger demo -> 3 hits, all in this file).

defects.defect: The K-INV5 'small-caps register' — named three times in this file's own comments and implemented as two inline `style="font-variant: small-caps"` attributes — is INERT. The sibling `text-mono-caption` utility applies `text-transform: uppercase`, which consumes the lowercase letters before small capitals can be synthesised from them, so the declaration cannot have any effect.
defects.evidence: Measured on the SHIPPED span (evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-b.mjs, real owned-remote menu via LAN host + stubbed feed): `::B1_realAnnotation widths {asShipped_smallCapsPlusUppercase: 55.266, smallCapsRemoved_uppercaseKept: 55.266, uppercaseRemoved_smallCapsKept: 39.094, bothRemoved: 55.266}`, `smallCapsIsInert: true`. Synthetic control: `withUppercaseUtility ON 64.469 / OFF 64.469 (delta 0)`, `withoutUppercaseUtility ON 59.266 / OFF 83.391 (delta 24.125)`. Utility source: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/typography/utilities.css `@utility text-mono-caption { ... text-transform: uppercase; }`. Component: PaletteCardMenu.vue:35-39 and :56-59; comments at :24-26 and :42-47. Corroborated by the AX name `"Make private PUBLIC"` (::B3_axMenuItems).
defects.mechanism: two mutually exclusive answers to the same design question (`text-transform: uppercase` vs `font-variant-caps: small-caps`) applied to the same element; CSS Text 3 runs the transform before CSS Fonts 4 synthesises small caps, so the later declaration is applied-and-inert
defects.reproduction: node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PaletteCardMenu/evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-b.mjs with PROBE_HOST set to the LAN host. Or in any page that loads the demo stylesheet: append `offline` and the same span without the inline style, and compare getBoundingClientRect().width — identical.
defects.proposedCure: Define the register once in glass-ui as a named utility (`@utility text-annotation`) that uses `font-variant-caps: small-caps` and NOT `text-transform: uppercase`, and consume it as a single class at both call sites. That deletes both inline `style=` attributes (curing C2-12), gives C2-9's `aria-hidden` one place to live, and makes the register a real named thing. If the owner in fact wants uppercase, delete both inline declarations and every comment that names a small-caps register — because uppercase is what ships.

defects.defect: Every menu trigger on the page resolves the same accessible name, and the only per-palette disambiguator sits in a role-less `generic` that `role="menu"` is not permitted to own — so AT in menu-navigation mode cannot tell which palette's menu is open.
defects.evidence: pcm-p3-a.mjs `::A2_duplicateNames [["Palette menu", 6], ["Palettes", 2]]` on a 6-card /#/palettes; pcm-p3-b.mjs `::B2_browse_duplicateNames {cards: 2, dupes: [..., ["Palette menu", 2]]}` — count == card count. AX tree of the open menu: `::A3_menuAXSubtree [{d:0, role:"menu", name:"Palette menu"}, {d:1, role:"generic", name:""}, {d:2, role:"StaticText", name:"Probe Palette 0"}, ...]`; `::A8_menuShape menuAttrs {ariaLabel: null, ariaLabelledby: "reka-dropdown-menu-trigger-v-1-2"}`. Primitive source: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Menu/MenuLabel.js renders `as: 'div'` with no role. Component: PaletteCardMenu.vue:9-11; trigger literal at PaletteCard.vue:100.
defects.mechanism: identifying information placed in a decorative node (WAI-ARIA 1.2 §menu Required Owned Elements does not include `generic`) while the operable control that AT actually enumerates carries a constant literal name
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/palettes with >1 saved palette and enumerate `document.querySelectorAll('button')` accessible names, or run pcm-p3-a.mjs. Six buttons, one name. Then open a menu and read the CDP AX subtree: the palette name is StaticText under an unnamed generic, never a menuitem.
defects.proposedCure: Name the trigger for what it operates on — `:aria-label="`Palette menu: ${palette.name}`"` in the trigger slot — and give the menu the same name via `:aria-label` on DropdownMenuContent. The DropdownMenuLabel then stays a purely visual header and can be `aria-hidden="true"` together with C2-9's annotation spans: one decision, three defects.

defects.defect: The Export submenu ships a different typographic voice from the menu it descends from: `class="text-caption"` on DropdownMenuSubContent (:112) contributes `font-style: italic` to five items, while the size it was evidently reached for never lands because the item recipe re-declares font-size.
defects.evidence: pcm-p3-d.mjs `::D1_typographySplit` — parent items `Publish/Rename/Export/Delete` all `fontStyle "normal", fontSize "16.4px", lineHeight "22.96px"`; submenu items `JSON/CSS Custom Properties/Tailwind Config/SVG Swatch/PNG Swatch` all `fontStyle "italic", fontSize "16.4px", lineHeight "21.32px"`. Utility source: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/typography/semantic.css `@utility text-caption { ... font-style: italic; ... }`; `::D2_utilityDefinitions` confirms text-small normal/16.4px vs text-caption italic/14.384px. Visible in evidence/pass-3/mobile-submenu.png.
defects.mechanism: a semantic type utility selected for one of its properties (size) and shipped for a different one (style), applied per-instance to a glass-ui primitive — edict-5 shape
defects.reproduction: node .../evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-d.mjs, or open a card menu on /#/palettes, open the Export submenu (keyboard: focus Export, ArrowRight), and compare getComputedStyle(item).fontStyle between the two surfaces.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `class="text-caption"` from :112 — the submenu then inherits the family voice from the item recipe, as every other menu in the app does. If the export list genuinely wants a quieter register, that is a DropdownMenuSubContent variant in glass-ui, not a type utility bolted onto one call site.

defects.defect: On a 390px viewport the Export submenu (301.4 x 243) occludes its own parent menu by 150.1 x 95.9 px (14,395 px²), covering the `Export` row it descends from and the `Delete` item below it, and is collision-shifted flush to x = 0 with no collision-padding and no width cap.
defects.evidence: pcm-p3-c.mjs, devices['iPhone 14'], 390x664: `::C2_menuPlusSubmenu` menu `{x:151.3, y:235.7, w:192, h:245.6, right:343.3, bottom:481.2}`, submenu `{side:"left", x:0, y:385.3, w:301.4, h:243, right:301.4, bottom:628.3}`, `overlap {xPx:150.1, yPx:95.9, area:14395}`. Screenshot evidence/pass-3/mobile-submenu.png shows the Export chevron peeking past the submenu's right edge and the Delete trash glyph ghosted behind `oklab(... / 0.808)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(11px)`.
defects.mechanism: a fixed-width parent (`w-48`) paired with a content-sized child that is wider than its parent, with no collision-padding and no narrow-viewport strategy — floating-ui can only shift, so the child lands on top of its own anchor
defects.reproduction: node .../evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-c.mjs. Because C2-2 makes the submenu untouchable by tap, the probe opens it by keyboard (focus the Export item, ArrowRight) — which is why this has never been seen.
defects.proposedCure: Same cure as C2-2: on narrow viewports retire the submenu and render Export as an inline group in the parent menu. If the submenu survives, it needs a width matched to its parent and `:collision-padding="8"`. Fixing C2-2 without fixing this ships the occlusion to every phone user — they are one work item.

defects.defect: The API already emits the correct published boolean and the client already types it, but nothing in demo/ reads it and this component hand-rolls the predicate wrong (`palette.visibility !== "private"`, which calls an `unlisted` palette public).
defects.evidence: api/src/modules/palette/format.ts:86 `published: rest.visibility === "public"`; demo/palettes/types.ts:50-52 types `published?: boolean` with the invariant in its doc comment; `grep -rn "published" demo/palettes` returns exactly one hit — the declaration itself. PaletteCardMenu.vue:222 `const isPublic = computed(() => palette.visibility !== "private")`.
defects.mechanism: two derivations of one truth (server-side and client-side) with the client copy wrong and the server copy unread — the C2-5 enum->boolean collapse with an unused correct answer sitting beside it
defects.reproduction: grep -rn "published" demo/palettes  (one hit, types.ts:52). Live truth table already captured by pass 2's pcm-p2-g.mjs: an `unlisted` palette renders a row character-for-character identical to a `public` one.
defects.proposedCure: Read `palette.published` for the boolean question and `palette.visibility` for the state label, which is exactly the `state display + transition` shape C2-5 asks for — cheaper than pass 2's proposed `=== "public"` edit and it deletes a duplicated derivation instead of fixing one copy of it.

defects.defect: `.fira-code` — used by both annotation spans — is a demo-local fork of a glass-ui `@utility` of the same name. Measured as a strict subset of the original (it drops `font-feature-settings`), therefore entirely dead, and DESIGN.md still documents it as project-specific design surface.
defects.evidence: pcm-p3-a.mjs `::A4_firaCodeCascade rules [{layer:"(unlayered)", sel:".fira-code", css:"font-family: var(--font-mono);"}, {layer:"@layer utilities", sel:".fira-code", css:"font-family: var(--font-mono); font-feature-settings: \"liga\", \"calt\";"}]`; computed value still resolves to `"calt", "liga"`. Fork: demo/styles/utils.css:9-11, imported at demo/color-picker/App.vue:199. Original: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/typography/utilities.css. Stale doc: demo/DESIGN.md:55.
defects.mechanism: a demo-local duplicate of a design-system utility left behind after glass-ui absorbed it — edict 2 (no dual paths) and edict 4 (glass-ui is the design system)
defects.reproduction: node .../evidence/pass-3/pcm-p3-a.mjs and read ::A4_firaCodeCascade.rules — two rules, one unlayered and one in @layer utilities, for the same selector.
defects.proposedCure: Delete demo/styles/utils.css:9-11 and the `.fira-code` half of DESIGN.md:55. (`.fraunces` in the same block was not checked — out of this seat's scope.)

defects.defect: CORRECTION to C2-2's scope: the Export submenu IS fully keyboard-operable. Passes 1 and 2 both framed it as unreachable; reka opens sub-menus on Enter/Space/ArrowRight through a keydown path that never calls .click(), so @click.prevent cannot reach it. The defect is pointer activation only — and the item renders a chevron affordance that promises a submenu it cannot open on touch.
defects.evidence: node_modules/reka-ui/dist/Menu/utils.js:17-19 `SUB_OPEN_KEYS = { ltr: [...SELECTION_KEYS, "ArrowRight"] }` with `SELECTION_KEYS = ["Enter", " "]`; MenuSubTrigger.js handleKeyDown calls `menuContext.onOpenChange(true)` directly. Live: `::A5_keyboardWalk ["Publish","Rename","Export"]`, `::A5_afterEnterOnExport {menus: 2, items: [... 9 items ...], activeElement: "menuitem:JSON"}`, `::A5_afterArrowDownInSub {activeElement: "CSS Custom Properties"}`. Chevron: `::C3_touchTapOnExport subState.childSvgCount 2`.
defects.mechanism: an over-broad prior finding — the primitive routes keyboard activation around the click handler the modifier disables, so the blast radius is narrower than reported but the touch consequence is sharper
defects.reproduction: pcm-p3-a.mjs: focus the trigger, Enter, ArrowDown to Export, Enter — the submenu opens and focus lands on JSON.
defects.proposedCure: No code change of its own — it re-scopes C2-2. The disposition must say 'pointer activation is dead' rather than 'the submenu is unreachable', and the touch cure has to be C3-4's flat list rather than merely deleting the modifier.

defects.defect: CORRECTION to C2-8: e2e asserts on six menu items, not two — but the repo's live a11y battery's accessible-name leg checks NON-EMPTY only, which is structurally why C3-2 (six identical names) and C2-9 (annotation folded into the name) are green gates.
defects.evidence: Six specs assert six distinct items: palette-edit.spec.ts:48 /Rename/, palette-delete.spec.ts:48 /^Delete$/, palette-fork.spec.ts:48 /Remix/, palette-flag.spec.ts:44 /Report/, admin/flows/palette-feature.spec.ts:48 /^Feature$/, oracles/o10d-...census.spec.ts:328 /Versions/. Uncovered: Save, Publish, makePublic, makePrivate, editTags, adminDelete and all five Export items (`grep -rn "SVG Swatch|PNG Swatch|Tailwind Config|CSS Custom Properties|exportJSON" e2e src test` -> no output). Gate: e2e/smoke/admin/fixtures/a11y-battery.ts:14-17 and :78-105 — 'resolves a NON-EMPTY accessible name'. Infrastructure claim re-verified: `grep -rn "@vue/test-utils" test demo e2e` and `grep -rln "mount(" test demo/test` both empty.
defects.mechanism: a gate whose predicate is weaker than the property it is believed to protect — name-nonempty rather than name-uniqueness or name-matches-the-verb
defects.reproduction: Run the greps above. Then note that 'Palette menu' x6, 'Make private PUBLIC' and 'Versions 3' all satisfy the battery's leg-1 predicate.
defects.proposedCure: Add two legs to a11y-battery.ts: name uniqueness within a scope, and (for menuitems) name-equals-the-verb with annotations aria-hidden. Separately, pass-2's structural cure stands — extract the item table (kind x isOwned x isAdmin x availability x visibility -> items[] with label/annotation/disabled/action) into a pure function and unit-test it, since reka menu content does not render under jsdom and the repo has no component-mount infrastructure at all.

defects.defect: The Export items write attacker-controlled markup to disk: demo/palettes/export.ts interpolates both `c.css` and `palette.name` raw into SVG, so a colour string can break out of the fill attribute and inject an event handler; the same malformation then kills PNG export, which fails with only a console.warn.
defects.evidence: Source re-verified this pass: demo/palettes/export.ts:66 `fill="${c.css}"`, :73 `>${palette.name}<`, :84 exportAsPNG re-serialises the same string. api/src/modules/palette/schema.ts:28 validates a colour as `css: z.string().min(1).max(200)` — no grammar, no escaping. Pass-2 probe pcm-p2-i.mjs captured the downloaded file body containing `fill="#00ddaa" onload="alert(1)"`. Silent catch at usePaletteExport.ts:22-24.
defects.mechanism: string-concatenation document construction over unvalidated remote input, plus a masking catch that swallows the failure the card already has a channel to report
defects.reproduction: Pass-2 probe evidence/pass-2/pcm-p2-i.mjs (not re-run this pass; source re-read and confirmed unchanged at HEAD c654824e). Seed a palette named `Ampersand & <tag> "quote"` with a colour `'#00ddaa" onload="alert(1)'` and use Export -> SVG Swatch.
defects.proposedCure: Build the SVG with document.createElementNS + setAttribute, which cannot be broken out of by construction and is no more code; guard colors.length === 0 before offering the raster/vector items; route every catch in usePaletteExport into the existing showFeedback(msg, "error") channel that PaletteCard already exposes.

defects.defect: `apiOffline = availability.value === "unavailable"` collapses a 4-state latch, missing `misconfigured` — the harder failure, in which the transport short-circuits every call. The running dev server is in exactly that state, so Publish renders enabled and produces a misleading error.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:216-217; demo/platform/transport/availability.ts:40-44 `type ApiAvailability = "unknown" | "available" | "unavailable" | "misconfigured"`. Re-observed live this pass: `::E2_deleteOnMix.consoleSinceStart` still carries `"[value.js] value.js dev is MISCONFIGURED: http://localhost:9000 has no VITE_API_URL ..."`, and `::A8_menuShape` shows Publish rendering with no aria-disabled. The sibling consumer demo/palettes/browser/status/ApiOfflineChip.vue:35-37 derives both states; test/status-lamp.test.ts:88 codifies 'misconfigured != unavailable'.
defects.mechanism: a partial equality against an enum, hand-rolled at a consumer instead of derived once at the seam that owns the latch
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/palettes (no VITE_API_URL) and open a saved palette's menu — Publish is enabled with no 'offline' annotation. Pass-2 probe pcm-p2-b.mjs measured the resulting feedback string: 'Failed to create session'.
defects.proposedCure: Do not add a fourth copy of the predicate. `useApiClient()` owns the latch and should expose the derived degraded state plus the reason, so all three consumers read one definition — that kills the drift class rather than this instance of it.

defects.defect: Choosing `Rename` gives the inline input focus for ~212 ms and then reka's close-time focus restoration takes it back to the trigger, because the guard meant to keep the menu open is dead: `if (action !== "rename") menuOpen.value = false` protects a branch whose handler sets `menuOpen.value = false` on its own first line.
defects.evidence: PaletteCard.vue:317 guard; PaletteCard.vue:280-283 `startRenaming()` sets menuOpen.value = false immediately; PaletteRenameInput.vue:53-56 focuses onMounted. Pass-2 trace pcm-p2-b.mjs `::focusLog [{t:6424, DIV Rename item}, {t:6431, INPUT}, {t:6643, BUTTON "Palette menu"}]`, `::activeElementByFrame` INPUT firstFrame 0 -> BUTTON firstFrame 11. Source re-read and unchanged this pass.
defects.mechanism: a dead conditional whose comment describes behaviour the code never implements, racing a primitive's focus-restore
defects.reproduction: Open a saved palette's menu on /#/palettes and choose Rename; the caret appears in the field for ~11 frames then returns to the `...` trigger.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the dead guard and use the hook that exists for exactly this — `@close-auto-focus.prevent` on DropdownMenuContent for the rename path — or move focus in the nextTick after the restore rather than racing it. Also give the rename input an accessible name; pass 2 measured `ariaLabel: null, labelled: false`.

defects.defect: On /#/mix the menu trigger is a native <button> nested inside the selection <button> that wraps each PaletteCard, and the card root is role="article" — both illegal in a button's content model (WCAG 4.1.2 / axe nested-interactive). The only thing keeping menu use from also toggling selection is a @click.stop in a different component.
defects.evidence: Re-measured at a different seed size this pass: `::E0_mixState {cards: 5, nestedButtons: 5, triggers: 5}` — scales 1:1 (pass 2 measured 30/30). Source: demo/workbenches/mix/MixSourceSelector.vue:246-268 `<button v-for=... ><PaletteCard :palette="palette" :css-color="''" /></button>` with no handlers bound; PaletteCard.vue:96-104 renders the trigger button unconditionally; the fence is PaletteCard.vue:82 @click.stop.
defects.mechanism: an unconditional action-menu child inside a card that a host wants to use as a selection control — the composition decision belongs to the host and is not expressed anywhere
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/mix in Palettes mode and evaluate document.querySelectorAll('button button').length — one per card.
defects.proposedCure: The same cure as C2-1: whether the menu renders must be the host's decision, not an unconditional child of PaletteCard. The menu is 100% dead at this host anyway.

defects.defect: `isPublic = palette.visibility !== "private"` collapses a 3-state field to a boolean, so an `unlisted` palette renders byte-identical to a public one, is annotated 'public', and is offered a `Make private` verb that emits setVisibility(p, "private") and destroys the middle state with no UI path back.
defects.evidence: PaletteCardMenu.vue:222; demo/palettes/types.ts:39-40 `visibility?: "public" | "unlisted" | "private"`; PaletteCard.vue:212 declares a two-valued emit for a three-valued field. Pass-2 live truth table (pcm-p2-g.mjs) shows the UNLISTED row character-for-character identical to the PUBLIC row. Both sides of the wire promise the opposite: demo/palettes/api/palettes.ts:128-130 and api/src/modules/palette/service/visibility.ts:7-8.
defects.mechanism: enum->boolean collapse in the view layer; the same mechanism recurs at :159-161 for the 3-state `tier`, where `archived` is mislabelled 'Feature'
defects.reproduction: Pass-2 probe evidence/pass-2/pcm-p2-g.mjs (LAN host + stubbed browse feed with one palette per visibility state).
defects.proposedCure: See C3-5 — read the `published` boolean the API already emits for the boolean question and `visibility` for the state label, then offer state display + the missing transition rather than a toggle that pretends the middle state does not exist. The API treats all three as legal resting states; the UI is the only layer that flattened it.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt, `demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue` (pass 3; passes 1 and 2 preserved and re-adjudicated)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`, the 1M-context variant. Spawned with an explicit Opus 5 declaration; served tier matches. No inheritance, no undeclared tier, no silent downgrade.

defects.defect: A localStorage store payload that passes the deserializer's ONLY validation check (`typeof parsed.version === "number"`) whiteouts the ENTIRE application on EVERY route, permanently. `usePaletteStore.read()` casts instead of parsing; `savedPalettes` is a module-level computed doing `.value.palettes.filter(...)`; it is read in App's OWN template (`demo/color-picker/App.vue:154`), so ErrorBoundary — a descendant — cannot catch it. The app never boots, therefore never writes, therefore never repairs the poisoned storage.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/usePaletteStore.ts:19-37 (read() body), :51-55 (module computed), demo/color-picker/App.vue:154. Measured (pp3-A-malformed.mjs, 11 shapes / 11 fresh contexts): `no_palettes_key | grid=false | cards=0 | bodyLen=0 | pageErr=2 | Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')`; same for palettes_null, palettes_object, palettes_string, null_entry. Blast radius (pp3-B-blast.mjs B1): `/#/ /#/palettes /#/browse /#/blob /#/admin/users` ALL → {"appHTMLLen":167,"bodyText":0,"canvases":0} pageErrors:2. Persistence (B2): reload 1/2/3 → {"bodyText":0,"stored":"{\"version\":1}"}. Ingress row `version_2_future`: a {"version":2,...} payload is accepted verbatim — the version field gates nothing.
defects.mechanism: unvalidated-boundary — untrusted bytes are cast to a domain type at the single storage ingress, and the resulting projection is evaluated on the root component's render path outside any error boundary
defects.reproduction: localStorage.setItem('color-palettes', '{"version":1}'); open http://localhost:9000/#/ (or any route). Page renders zero text; #app holds only the 167-char mount shell; 2 pageErrors; three reloads stay blank. Script: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/PalettesPane/probes-pass3/pp3-A-malformed.mjs and pp3-B-blast.mjs
defects.proposedCure: Make `read()` PARSE rather than cast — it is the single choke point for every store ingress. Validate array-ness and per-entry required fields, drop malformed entries, return defaultStore on total failure; then `PaletteStore` is a type rather than an assertion, `savedPalettes` cannot throw, and P-3 dies with it. Second layer: nothing downstream of a localStorage read belongs un-guarded on the root component's render path.

defects.defect: The pane's expand gesture is wired onto a non-interactive element, and it gates every per-colour control in the component. `PalettesPane.vue:91` puts `@click="pm.toggleExpand(palette.id)"` on a `role="article"` div with no tabindex, no keydown handler, no button semantics. Because `PaletteCardSwatches` is `v-if="expanded"`, edit-colour (`pm.onEditColor`), copy-colour, add-colour and copy-slug are ALL unreachable by keyboard — as is reorder. The card menu offers no expand substitute.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:91; demo/palettes/browser/card/PaletteCard/PaletteCard.vue:5-27 (role=article, no tabindex), :139-140 (v-if="expanded"), :293-313 (menu action set, no expand); PaletteCardSwatches.vue:11-18,40-59. Measured (pp3-C-drag.mjs C4, 4 palettes, 30 Tabs): pane-scoped focus stops = input(search), button 'Delete all saved palettes', then 'Palette menu' ×4 — `stops inside a palette card: 4`; `card element: {"tabindex":null,"role":"article","hasKeyHandler":false}`. Live menu contents for a local saved palette (pp3-E2-refs.mjs E4): ["Publish","Rename","Export","Delete"].
defects.mechanism: semantics/behaviour mismatch — an interactive gesture attached to a non-interactive ARIA role, with the entire dependent control set rendered behind that gesture
defects.reproduction: Seed 4 palettes into localStorage['color-palettes'], open /#/palettes, press Tab repeatedly. The only stop inside any card is its 'Palette menu' button; the card body, title-rename span and drag handle are never focusable, so the expanded swatch panel (and every control in it) can never be opened without a mouse. Script: probes-pass3/pp3-C-drag.mjs (section C4)
defects.proposedCure: Make the disclosure a disclosure. Give the card a real `<button>` summary row (or `tabindex="0"` + `aria-expanded` + Enter/Space on the row) and move collection membership onto `role="listitem"`. Adding tabindex to the article div is the patch; giving the gesture the semantics it implies is the transposition.

defects.defect: An `isLocal: true` palette with no `id` is invisible to both store projections, excluded from the header count, and SURVIVES 'Delete all saved palettes'. `savedPalettes` requires `p.isLocal && p.id != null`; `publishedPalettes` requires `!p.isLocal`; the entry satisfies neither. `onDeleteAllSaved` iterates `savedPalettes`, so no gesture in the application can remove it — while the confirm dialog promises the user a permanent delete.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/usePaletteStore.ts:51-55 and :57-59 (the two projections); demo/palettes/usePaletteActions.ts:125-131 (onDeleteAllSaved iterates savedPalettes); demo/palettes/types.ts:24 states the invariant `isLocal === true ⟹ id present` with nothing enforcing it. Measured (pp3-B-blast.mjs B3): before delete-all `{"stored":["Visible","OrphanNoId"],"rendered":["Palette: Visible"],"badge":"My Palettes1 (1 saved)"}`; after clicking Delete all + confirming `{"stored":["OrphanNoId"],"rendered":0}`.
defects.mechanism: unvalidated-boundary (same root as P-1) surfacing as silent undeletable data retention rather than a crash — a doc-comment invariant with no enforcement where untrusted bytes enter
defects.reproduction: localStorage.setItem('color-palettes', JSON.stringify({version:1,palettes:[{id:'a',name:'Visible',slug:'visible',colors:[{css:'#f00',position:0}],createdAt:'x',updatedAt:'x',isLocal:true},{name:'OrphanNoId',slug:'orphan',colors:[{css:'#0f0',position:0}],createdAt:'x',updatedAt:'x',isLocal:true}]})); open /#/palettes; badge reads '1 saved'; click 'Delete all saved palettes' → confirm; OrphanNoId is still in localStorage. Script: probes-pass3/pp3-B-blast.mjs (section B3)
defects.proposedCure: Enforce the stated invariant at the same choke point as P-1: `read()` mints an id for, or drops, any `isLocal` entry lacking one. An invariant that lives only in a doc comment is not an invariant.

defects.defect: The application's own documented global prefers-reduced-motion guard is inert. `demo/styles/animations.css:184-192` declares `transition-duration: 0.01ms !important` on `*` and comments that it 'neutralises ... transitions app-wide'. `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/utilities/a11y-overrides.css` ships a LATER `!important` rule of equal specificity and origin setting `0.1s`, which wins by source order. Two competing app-wide PRM policies with different values; the losing one carries the authoritative comment.
defects.evidence: demo/styles/animations.css:177-192 vs node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/utilities/a11y-overrides.css (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *:not([data-allow-motion]) { transition-duration: 0.1s !important; transition-property: opacity, color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow !important; } }`). Measured on a palette card with Playwright reducedMotion:'reduce' (pp3-D-prm-taps.mjs D1): {"matchMedia":true,"computedTransitionDuration":"0.1s","computedAnimationDuration":"1e-05s","matchingTransitionRules":[{"sel":":not([data-allow-motion])","val":"0.1s","imp":"important"},{"sel":"*, ::before, ::after","val":"0.01ms","imp":"important"}]} — 0.1s, not the declared 0.01ms, a factor of 10 000.
defects.mechanism: dual path / conflicting authority — two app-wide guards for one policy, resolved silently by stylesheet source order, with the dead one carrying the documentation
defects.reproduction: Launch chromium with reducedMotion:'reduce', open /#/palettes with any seeded palette, evaluate getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[role=article]')).transitionDuration → "0.1s". Script: probes-pass3/pp3-D-prm-taps.mjs (section D1)
defects.proposedCure: Delete the demo block. The producer's policy is the real one and is deliberate (glass-ui's 100 ms floor plus a `[data-allow-motion]` opt-out); the demo has been overriding it in name only for the life of the file. Owner edict 2 forbids the dual path. BH/glass-ui relay item.

defects.defect: `demo/ui/*` is a pure alias layer — 18 of 19 barrels are a single-line re-export of `@mkbabb/glass-ui` — and PalettesPane reaches the design system through BOTH paths within one import block twenty lines apart: Card/Button/Badge via the `../ui/*` aliases, Dialog/SearchBar directly from `@mkbabb/glass-ui/*`.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/PalettesPane.vue:129-131 (aliases) vs :141-149 (direct). `cat demo/ui/card/index.ts` → `export { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";` (1 line); same for button and badge. Counted across the tree: `demo/ui barrels: 19 ; pure glass-ui re-export barrels: 18`.
defects.mechanism: migration residue — an aliasing indirection left standing after the shadcn→glass-ui move, with no rule left governing which path a consumer takes
defects.reproduction: NONE — static; verified by reading the three barrels PalettesPane imports and counting all 19 under demo/ui/.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the pure re-export barrels and import glass-ui directly at every call site (owner edicts 2 and 4). Keep only the one barrel that actually adds something.

defects.defect: The pane's only feedback channel is not a live region, and its auto-dismiss timer outlives the component. `ActionFeedback.vue` renders a plain `<div>` with no `role="status"` / `aria-live`, so the async network-backed publish result is announced to no assistive technology. Its dismiss timer is created in a `watch` and cleared only by the next visibility change — never on unmount — so a card unmounted while the chip is visible fires `emit` into a disposed instance.

result.strongestDefect: P-1 — a `localStorage` payload that the store deserializer's only validation accepts (`{"version":1}`) blanks the ENTIRE application on EVERY route, permanently. Measured `bodyText: 0` on /#/, /#/palettes, /#/browse, /#/blob and /#/admin/users; `#app` holds only its 167-char mount shell; /#/blob renders zero canvases. It is unrecoverable in-app — the tree never mounts, so `useStorage` never writes, so three consecutive reloads stay blank and the user's only remedy is DevTools. The realistic trigger is not hand-editing: `read()` accepts any numeric `version` with zero migration, so the `version` field that exists to gate a schema change gates nothing, and one shipped reshape of `palettes` bricks every client still on a cached bundle. It produces two page errors and no console errors, and the audit harness can never see it because it only ever visits the app with a clean store. It outranks the carried C-1 (first-drag library scramble) because its blast radius is the whole application rather than one pane, and because it has no recovery path at all.
result.negativeProof: N/A — verdict is DEFECTIVE. Recorded here instead are the five hypotheses I measured and REFUTED, so no later seat re-runs them: (1) post-drag click leakage toggling expand — REFUTED, `expanded swatch-panels before/after drag: 0 / 0`; SortableJS's capture-phase `ignoreNextClick` suppressor (sortable.esm.js:1014-1023) works. (2) Forced synchronous layout during drag scaling with card count — REFUTED, `offsetWidth` getter instrumented: 9 forced reads at n=4, 9 at n=20, 9 at n=60 — constant, not linear. (3) Duplicate-`id` palette loss in `reorderPalettes`'s `new Map(...)` — REFUTED by enumeration: every store ingress mints a fresh key (createPalette `crypto.randomUUID()` usePaletteStore.ts:85; addPublishedPalette `palette.id ?? crypto.randomUUID()` :147 over remote rows that carry no `id` by contract, types.ts:16-26). (4) Hover swatch popover mispositioned/clipped by `contain: layout style paint` on `.pane-scroll-fade` — REFUTED by construction: the panel is inside `<Teleport to="body">` (SwatchHoverMenu.vue:35-49), outside the contained subtree. (5) `--palettes-ramp-title-*` undefined so the certified title ramp silently falls back — REFUTED: written at runtime by demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useViewAccents.ts:163. One hypothesis is INCONCLUSIVE, not refuted: publish double-submit creating two remote palettes — with the API stubbed at 1200ms latency, two invocations produced `API requests: []` because availability.ts's W0-1 latch short-circuits all API traffic on a loopback page with no VITE_API_URL (the DEV MISCONFIGURED banner is visible in my capture); the static concern stands unproven (onPublish has no in-flight flag, and createAndSavePalette mints a fresh idempotency key per call, which cannot collapse a user double-submit, contradicting its own comment at api/palettes.ts:78-80).
