result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, so this records the claims I tested and could NOT substantiate — the negatives I owe so no downstream seat re-litigates them. (1) "The picker dialog is unnamed" — FALSE. Measured aria-labelledby="reka-popover-trigger-v-1-7" → the trigger's live label "Open color picker, current color #4488cc" (SearchFilterBar.vue:78); the dialog has a correct live accessible name. (2) "Motion is ad hoc / ignores prefers-reduced-motion" — FALSE. The component declares ZERO transitions, animations and keyframes; its only motion is the producer's `glass-reveal` on PopoverContent (measured in the dialog class list), covered by the repo's global reduce guard. Owner edict 6 is not engaged. D-15 is about imperative layout writes, not animation. (3) "Opening the child dismisses the parent" — FALSE; dialogCount 2 with both live in every desktop matrix, corroborating the SearchFilterBar seat. (4) "variant='outline' is a typecheck error" — FALSE and worse: `npx vue-tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit` is CLEAN at HEAD c654824e, so the dead prop is silent, not caught (the earlier TS2353 at SearchFilterBar/challenge-L-library.md:120-123 no longer reproduces). (5) "It is a god module" — FALSE; 164 lines, one job, no shared-dir contrivance; edict 1 clean. (6) verbatimModuleSyntax — CLEAN; every import at :61-63 is value-position, no type-only import required; edict 8 ✔. (7) Vue 3.5 idioms — CLEAN; useTemplateRef at :82-83, reactive props destructure at :65, no defineModel so the shallowRef stale-read caveat does not apply; edict 7 ✔. (8) "RTL is broken" — FALSE as rendered; shots/rtl-desktop-mini.png mirrors the output row correctly and the SV/hue axes correctly stay physical per VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:152 §6.1; only the LTR-isolation law (D-19) is unmet. (9) "Horizontal overflow" — FALSE; audit/visual/REPORT.json reports overflowX 0 for /#/browse and /#/palettes in all four shipped matrices and my probes reproduce none at 1440/720/390 with both dialogs open. (10) The static-gradient split at :157-163 (static SV overlay in scoped CSS, only the dynamic --hue through :style) is CORRECT and must not be "fixed" — carry it forward. (11) The forced-colors row of D-17 is an explicit HYPOTHESIS, not a measurement: WebKit does not truly emulate forced-colors, so no forced-colors defect is claimed. (12) Coverage caveat recorded for the record: MiniColorPicker appears in ZERO of the 60 shipped Safari captures and zero of the 30 STATES.json rows — it is two popovers deep, so every frame in this report is new.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-C — implementation (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue, area palettes)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id `claude-opus-5[1m]`; spawned with an explicit Opus 5 declaration, not inherited.

defects.defect: The first open of the version drawer never fetches: the load is bound to the `open` edge via a non-immediate watcher, but the host mounts the component with `open` already true, so no edge exists. The user sees "<palette> — 0 versions" and an empty body; closing and reopening fixes it.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/dialog/VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:158-167 (watch(() => open, …) with no `immediate`) + demo/palettes/BrowsePane.vue:157-164 (`v-if="versionPalette"`) + :272-275 (`versionPalette.value = palette; versionDrawerOpen.value = true;` in one function, one render). LIVE (Chromium, real dev build, 30 versions served): `FIRST OPEN: {"head":"Version HistoryWall Palette 1 — 0 versions…","rowCount":0} calls: []` at BOTH 1280×900 and 375×812; `SECOND OPEN: {…"rowCount":20…} calls: ["/palettes/wall-palette-1/versions?limit=20&offset=0"]`; CONSOLE ERRORS: []. Frame: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/VersionHistoryDrawer/evidence-C/vhd-first-open-EMPTY.png. Component probe (real SFC, @vue/test-utils): `FIRST OPEN fetchVersions calls: 0`.
defects.mechanism: visibility-edge-bound async load with no immediate/init path; host mounts already-open
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-live2.mjs against a dev build with VITE_API_URL set: /#/browse → card menu → Versions → 0 rows, 0 network calls; Escape, reopen → 20 rows. Also reproduced headless in vitest+jsdom by replicating BrowsePane.onVersions().
defects.proposedCure: Do not bind the fetch to a visibility edge. Bind it to the identity being displayed — `watch(() => (open ? paletteSlug : null), slug => slug && load(slug), { immediate: true })` — which simultaneously closes the 'slug changed while open' hole. The gestalt cure is one level up and is the same as C-11: delete the drawer's private copy of the paging state machine and consume `pm.versions` (useVersionHistory.ts:45-128), whose versions/total/loading/loadVersions/loadMore/reset already exist with zero consumers.

defects.defect: `Revert` — a destructive action — is rendered for users who cannot perform it (no ownership input anywhere in the component), and the guaranteed 403 fails completely silently: no toast, no message, no state change.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:118-123 (prop surface is only open/paletteSlug/paletteName/currentHash — no ownership) and :75-84 (Revert on every non-current row); PaletteCardMenu.vue:94 gates the Versions item on `!palette.isLocal && (palette.versionCount ?? 0) > 1` only. LIVE 403 probe: `BEFORE`/`AFTER` drawer and card text byte-identical; `NET: ["POST revert -> 403"]`; `LOGS: ["error: … 403 (Forbidden)", "warning: Failed to revert: ApiProblem: Forbidden"]`. Swallowed at useVersionHistory.ts:88-95 (console.warn) and BrowsePane.vue:277-284 (`if (!updated) return`).
defects.mechanism: unauthorized destructive affordance + swallowed error with no user-facing failure surface
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/revert.mjs 403 — anonymous visitor, palette owned by `gallery`, click the first Revert; UI unchanged, only a console.warn.
defects.proposedCure: Pass `:is-owned` (BrowsePane already computes ownership for the cards) and render Revert only for the owner; route a rejected revert through the repo's existing failure surface `cardRefs[slug]?.showFeedback(message, "error")` (BrowsePane.vue:264 / ActionFeedback.vue). No new toast system — the affordance exists.

defects.defect: 28 of the drawer's 30 focusable controls compute to `opacity: 0` while remaining focusable and hit-testable, with no focus reveal and `outline: none` — invisible destructive buttons a keyboard user tabs through and a touch user can tap without seeing.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:79 `class="mt-2 h-7 text-caption opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"`. LIVE: `FOCUS: {"focusableCount":30,"invisibleFocusable":28,"firstInvisibleText":"Revert"}`; `REVERT KEYBOARD/HIT-TEST: {"focused":true,"opacity":"0","outline":"none 3px","hitTestIsSelf":true,"rect":{"w":89,"h":36}}`; button census `{"name":"Revert","opacity":"0","pointerEvents":"auto","visibility":"visible"}`. Intra-repo drift: the other three `group-hover:opacity-100` sites all pair a focus escape — MixSourceSelector.vue:153, ImageDropZone.vue:58, AdminTagsPanel.vue:99. Frame evidence-C/vhd-hover-revert.png shows the reserved blank band on non-current rows.
defects.mechanism: hover-only reveal of an interactive control; opacity 0 leaves it focusable, hit-testable and unstyled for focus (WCAG 2.4.7)
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-live2.mjs (focus census) and the in-page `document.elementFromPoint(centre of the Revert rect)` hit test, which returns the button itself; on a coarse pointer `:hover` never resolves so the control is permanently invisible yet tappable.
defects.proposedCure: Stop hiding a destructive control: a permanently visible `Button variant="ghost" size="sm"` per row (the space is already reserved, so nothing moves). If a reveal must stay, it belongs in glass-ui as a `Button reveal="hover"` variant shipping `group-hover` + `group-focus-within` together (edicts 4/5), never as a per-instance class string; or move Revert into the row's own menu where every other destructive palette action lives.

defects.defect: Two counters over one concept: the card badge (`palette.versionCount`) and the drawer subtitle (`page.total`) provably diverge, guaranteed on every revert, and are visible on screen simultaneously.
defects.evidence: Drawer subtitle from `page.total` (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:11, :146) = `countByPaletteSlug` (api service/versions.ts:92-95); card badge from `versionCount` (PaletteCardMeta.vue:27-32). Server increments `$inc: { versionCount: 1 }` on revert (service/versions.ts:172) while `createVersionRecord` early-returns on an existing content hash (service/versions.ts:38-44) — which on a revert always exists. Same at service/crud.ts:186-193. LIVE 200 probe: `BEFORE card "Wall Palette 1 2 4 1" / drawer "— 4 versions"` → `AFTER card "… 2 5 1" / drawer "— 4 versions"`. The drawer also never refetches after emitting `revert` (no watcher on currentHash; BrowsePane.vue:283 only swaps the object).
defects.mechanism: duplicate source of truth for a count + hash-idempotent server writes + no post-mutation refetch
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/revert.mjs 200 (stub modelling the server exactly: versionCount 4→5, version rows unchanged) — card reads 5, drawer still reads 4, one click apart.
defects.proposedCure: One counter. Read the subtitle from the palette's own `versionCount` (already among the palette facts the drawer receives) or stop double-counting deduped reverts server-side; and derive the row ordinal from the record's `depth` rather than from a total that disagrees with the badge.

defects.defect: A failed version fetch renders exactly like an empty history (no error, no retry), and a failed/short load-more page leaves a button that silently re-issues the same doomed request forever.
defects.evidence: useVersionHistory.ts:56-62 swallows every error → `undefined`; drawer :141 `if (!page) return` inside the try, `finally` clears loading. Probe: `ERROR-PATH text: "Version HistoryP — 0 versions"` — identical to a genuinely empty history. Load-more probe with `{data: [], total: 40}` on page 2: `LOADMORE calls: 9 [["s",20,0],["s",20,2],["s",20,2], …]`, `LOADMORE still present: true` — 8 identical requests at a frozen offset. The server's untransacted `Promise.all([find, count])` (service/versions.ts:92-95) is a real producer of total>rows.
defects.mechanism: error swallowed at the port, no failure state in the view, progress bounded by a stale `total` instead of by page results
defects.reproduction: scratchpad vhd2.test.ts probes 'error path: fetch fails' and 'load-more when the server page comes back empty'.
defects.proposedCure: Give the drawer three honest states — loading / empty / failed+retry — using the vocabulary the app already ships (EmptyState at demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue, the apiAvailability latch, ApiOfflineChip). Let fetchVersions reject or return a discriminated result rather than `undefined`, and retire the load-more button when a page returns fewer rows than requested, regardless of `total`.

defects.defect: No request identity and no abort: a late response overwrites the list of a different palette, so the header names palette B while the rows (and every Revert hash) come from palette A.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:142-147 writes versions/total unconditionally on resolve; demo/palettes/api/versions.ts:24-32 takes no AbortSignal; the host never unmounts the instance (BrowsePane.vue:157 `v-if="versionPalette"`, never nulled) so one drawer serves every palette. Probe: `RACE calls: [['A',20,0],['B',20,0]]` → `RACE rendered text: "Version HistoryB — 2 versions v2 … v1 …"` (header B, rows+total from A). Combined with BrowsePane.vue:279, a Revert click then posts A's hash to B's slug.
defects.mechanism: unsequenced concurrent writes to shared view state; last-resolved wins
defects.reproduction: scratchpad vhd.test.ts 'interleaved-palette race': open A, close, open B, resolve B then A. Mechanism confirmed; production wall-clock frequency unmeasured (needs a slow first request) — labelled as such in the report.
defects.proposedCure: A monotonic request token discarded on staleness is the minimum (`const seq = ++reqId; … if (seq !== reqId) return;`); threading an AbortController through `listVersions` is the honest version — and it belongs in the single owner (useVersionHistory), not in a per-drawer copy.

defects.defect: The user-facing version ordinal is invented from array position (`v{{ total - i }}`) while the server's real lineage index (`PaletteVersion.depth`) is fetched and discarded; it renders `vNaN`, repeats labels, and can go negative.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:37; `depth` computed server-side at service/versions.ts:46-57 and typed at demo/palettes/types.ts:76, never read. LIVE (a wrong-shaped page reached the drawer): `"Version HistoryWall Palette 1 — versions vNaN Jul 4, 08:00 PM…"` — no validation, no error, three rows keyed `undefined`. Probe B (page 2 re-serves a loaded row, which the server's `sort({createdAt:-1}).skip()` at repository/paletteVersion.ts:22-27 produces under a concurrent insert): the same hash renders twice as v20 and v19, with no Vue duplicate-key warning. When versions.length > total the labels render v0, v-1.
defects.mechanism: identifier derived from mutable array position and a separately-fetched total instead of from the record
defects.reproduction: scratchpad vhd3.test.ts probe B; and the live run whose payload lacked `total` (rendered vNaN and a subtitle with no count).
defects.proposedCure: Label from the record — `depth` is exactly this number and is already on the wire — or drop the pseudo-version-number entirely and identify rows by short hash + timestamp, the idiom the fork line already uses at :71.

defects.defect: A palette with no version history renders a blank rectangle — no empty state — which is also the state the C-1 blocker and every C-5 failure land in, so broken, failed and genuinely empty are indistinguishable.
defects.evidence: Probe: `EMPTY: "Version HistoryP — 0 versions"` with an empty body (loading v-if false, v-for empty, load-more v-if false). The repo ships EmptyState (demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue, used by BrowsePane) and a documented dashed-well idiom for exactly this (demo/DESIGN.md:98); the drawer uses neither.
defects.mechanism: missing empty state collapses three distinct conditions into one blank surface
defects.reproduction: scratchpad vhd2.test.ts 'empty history renders no empty-state'.
defects.proposedCure: Reuse EmptyState with the dashed-well treatment, and make the failed state visually distinct from it (see C-5) so the three conditions read differently.

defects.defect: Accessibility of the rendered drawer, measured: zero aria-live/role=status, no list semantics, an unlabelled spinner, no aria-current on the current version, and a 16×16 close button below the 24×24 minimum.
defects.evidence: LIVE, drawer open with 20 rows: `aria-live/role=status count: 0`, `<ul>/<li> count: 0`, `closeBtn: {"w":16,"h":16}`, `swatch: {"w":20,"h":20}` (decorative divs, unlabelled). Spinner is a bare `<Loader2>` icon (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:18). Current-version marker is `ring-2 ring-primary` + a decorative 4×1 div (:29-32) with only the "(current)" text (:38) carrying it; no aria-current.
defects.mechanism: async result region with no live region; semantic list rendered as sibling divs; sub-minimum tap target inherited from the glass-ui close affordance
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-live2.mjs (a11y block); scratchpad vhd3.test.ts probe E (`aria-live count: 0`, `role= count: 0`, `<li|<ul: 0`).
defects.proposedCure: Announce the async result (`role="status" aria-live="polite"` on the count line, an accessible name on the spinner), render the rows as a real list with `aria-current="true"` on the current version, and fix the 16×16 close control in glass-ui's DialogContent (edict 4 — it is glass-ui's `showClose`, not a demo override).

defects.defect: The two width declarations the component ships are inert: it declares `w-[380px] sm:max-w-[420px]` and the element computes 384px (max-width 384px) at 1280 and 281px at 375 — dead per-instance overrides on a glass root component.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:3. Live getComputedStyle on the drawer root: `className: "… glass-floating w-[380px] sm:max-w-[420px] flex flex-col"`, `width: "384px"`, `maxWidth: "384px"`, `inset: "0px 0px 0px 896px"`; at 375px viewport `width 281px`, `overflowX 0`. The utilities ARE emitted — served CSS contains `.w-\[380px\]{width:380px}` and `.sm\:max-w-\[420px\]{@media (width>=40rem){max-width:420px}}` — they simply never win against glass-ui's side-sheet geometry.
defects.mechanism: per-instance styling overridden by the design-system root; the declaration survives as dead code
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/width2.mjs and width3.mjs against the live drawer.
defects.proposedCure: Delete both classes and set the side-sheet width where it is actually decided — a glass-ui DialogContent size/placement token (edict 5, root-level styling). If 380/420 is a real design intent, it has to become a variant in glass-ui, because as written it has never once taken effect.

defects.defect: The paging state machine exists twice — the drawer's private copy is a line-for-line clone of the composable's — and the shipped copy is the broken one; 7 of useVersionHistory's 10 members have zero consumers.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:137-155 vs useVersionHistory.ts:65-86 are identical apart from `paletteSlug.value = slug`. grep of every `pm.versions.*` call site in demo/ yields exactly three: fetchVersions (drawer :140), revert (BrowsePane.vue:279), fork (useDialogBrowseActions.ts:55) — leaving versions, total, loading, paletteSlug, loadVersions, loadMore, reset dead. The fork is recorded as a decision in the comment at :130-131.
defects.mechanism: deliberate dual path; the duplicated copy is where C-1, C-5 and C-6 live, and a fix to the composable would never reach the UI
defects.reproduction: grep -rn "versions\.(loadVersions|loadMore|reset|versions|total|loading|paletteSlug|fork|revert|fetchVersions)" demo/ | grep -v useVersionHistory.ts → 3 hits.
defects.proposedCure: One of the two must die. Preferred: delete the drawer's copy and render `pm.versions.versions` keyed by slug, which also fixes C-1 and gives C-6 a single place to add request identity. If per-drawer isolation is genuinely wanted, delete the composable's seven orphan members instead — but not both implementations.

defects.defect: Vacuous gate: the component has no unit test at all, and its single e2e touch asserts only the drawer title's font — it is currently green over the C-1 blocker.
defects.evidence: `test/**` and `demo/test/**` contain no reference to VersionHistoryDrawer, useVersionHistory or listVersions (`ls test/demo/palettes/api` → admin-palettes.test.ts only). The one e2e touch is e2e/smoke/oracles/o10d-display-voice-census.spec.ts:326-337: opens the drawer for the first time, asserts `fontFamily` matches the display face and `fontWeight <= 500` on the title, presses Escape.
defects.mechanism: the only gate asserts typography on a title, so every behavioural mutation passes
defects.reproduction: Exact mutation that keeps the suite green: replace the body of `loadVersions` with `{}` — functionally what ships today (C-1 issues no request on first open) while o10d is green. Also green under: deleting every Revert button, `.slice(0, 8)` → `.slice(0, 1)`, `v{{ total - i }}` → `v{{ i }}`, removing the (current) marker, deleting the load-more button.
defects.proposedCure: One ~30-line component test at the seam both audit seats used — mount the real SFC with a stubbed BROWSE_PORT_KEY, host it exactly as BrowsePane does, assert one row per version on the FIRST open. That single file would have caught C-1, C-5, C-6 and C-7.

defects.defect: The date helper's try/catch is unreachable dead code, and malformed timestamps render as confident lies — a null createdAt renders as a real epoch date.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/dateFormat.ts:2-13 wraps `toLocaleString`, which returns the string "Invalid Date" rather than throwing in V8/JSC. Probe of five boundary rows: `"… v5 Invalid Date … v4 Invalid Date … v3 Dec 31, 07:00 PM … v1 Dec 31, 06:59 PM"` — row v3 is `createdAt: null` rendered as the epoch. A `colors: null` row throws in the render function outright: `[Vue warn]: Unhandled error during execution of render function` + `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slice')` (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:53). No payload validation exists anywhere in the component.
defects.mechanism: dead defensive branch masquerading as a guard; unvalidated payload reaching the template
defects.reproduction: scratchpad vhd2.test.ts 'invalid + boundary timestamps' and vhd.test.ts 'empty collection + invalid/boundary timestamps'.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the dead try/catch and format through a module-level `Intl.DateTimeFormat` that checks `Number.isNaN(d.getTime())` and renders an explicit dash for an unknown time; validate the page shape once at the port (the single owner) rather than trusting `page.data`/`page.total` in the view.

defects.defect: During load-more the only progress feedback renders at the top of a scrolled container — off-screen from the button the user just clicked.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:17-19 places the spinner as the FIRST child of the `overflow-y-auto` column; the 'Load older versions' button is the LAST child (:88-97), reached by scrolling to the bottom. The button itself only goes `disabled` (:93) with no busy state.
defects.mechanism: progress indicator not co-located with the action that starts it
defects.reproduction: NONE — deterministic from DOM order and the scroll container; labelled a code-read certainty, not a live measurement.
defects.proposedCure: Put the busy state on the control that owns the action (a spinner inside the load-more Button) and reserve the top spinner for the initial load only.

defects.defect: formatTime constructs a fresh Intl formatter per row per render — 11.2× the cost of one cached DateTimeFormat, in a helper shared across the palette surface.
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/browser/dateFormat.ts:2-13 (`new Date(iso).toLocaleString(undefined, {…})`). Benchmark, 20 000 iterations: `toLocaleString per call: 24.39 µs | cached Intl.DateTimeFormat: 2.18 µs | ratio 11.2` → 0.488 ms vs 0.044 ms per 20-row render.
defects.mechanism: formatter allocation inside the render path
defects.reproduction: node -e benchmark, pasted output in the report.
defects.proposedCure: Hoist one module-level `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in dateFormat.ts and reuse it (both formatTime and formatDate).

defects.defect: The drawer and its composable are eagerly loaded on every route, including routes that never mount them.
defects.evidence: Cold load of /#/, performance.getEntriesByType("resource"): 250 resources including demo/palettes/browser/dialog/VersionHistoryDrawer.vue and demo/palettes/useVersionHistory.ts. Confirms DEFECT-LEDGER:13805 (the App.vue → dialog barrel edge).
defects.mechanism: barrel re-export pulls the whole dialog cluster into the eager chunk
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/eager.mjs against the dev build.
defects.proposedCure: Already booked at the App/bundle-config level — the dialog barrel edge from App.vue should reach MigratePalettesDialog without dragging the other two dialogs; recorded here only as a fresh receipt.

result.strongestDefect: C-1 — the drawer's first open never fetches (watch on the `open` edge with no `immediate`, while BrowsePane mounts it already open): live at both viewports the first open renders "<palette> — 0 versions" with rowCount 0 and ZERO network calls, no console error; close and reopen and it loads 20 rows / "30 versions". The feature is broken on first use in shipping code, and the only e2e that touches the component opens it for the first time and asserts nothing but the title's font — so the gate is green over the blocker.
result.negativeProof: Not applicable to the verdict (DEFECTIVE), but recorded as positive evidence for what I checked and did NOT find, so the absence is proven rather than assumed: (1) no leaks — the component registers no listener, observer, timer or rAF and touches no WebGL, and unmounting mid-flight resolves without a throw (probe: "UNMOUNT: resolved after unmount without throw; calls: 1"); (2) the `defineModel` stale-read hazard cannot apply — `open` is an explicit prop + `update:open` emit (:118-128), no defineModel anywhere; (3) no colour parsing — `:style="{ backgroundColor: c.css }"` hands the string to CSSOM, which drops invalid values silently, so the live parseCssColor crash class is unreachable here; no ValueUnit wrapping, no oklch→HSV roundtrip, no slider/pointer-capture; (4) verbatimModuleSyntax clean — `import type { PaletteVersion }` (:116) is the only type-only import and it is marked; reactive props destructure (:118) is idiomatic Vue 3.5; (5) the 8-swatch cap plus honest `+N` chip (:53-63) is the repo's good precedent, measured live as overflowChip "+3" on 11-colour versions; (6) NO horizontal overflow at 375px — measured width 281px with `document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth === 0`, which falsifies the obvious `w-[380px]`-overflows-mobile hypothesis (kept in the report as a falsified hypothesis); (7) zero console errors and zero page errors across every live drawer session; (8) Escape closes and glass-ui restores focus to the trigger, and `role="dialog"` is present on the content.

result.axis: CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-system boundary, proportion/seat law)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m], 1M-context variant) — declared at spawn, not inherited

defects.defect: The drawer's FIRST open always renders blank — no versions request is ever issued. `watch(() => open, ...)` at VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:158-167 lacks `immediate: true`, while BrowsePane.vue:157 mounts the component via `v-if="versionPalette"` with `open` already true, so the watched value never changes.
defects.evidence: evidence-D/probe2.json: firstOpenVersionRequests = [".../demo/palettes/api/versions.ts"] (module fetch only) · firstOpen.rowCount = 0 · firstOpen.bodyText = "Version HistoryCensus Palette — 0 versionsClose". secondOpenVersionRequests adds "http://localhost:9111/palettes/census-palette/versions?limit=20&offset=0" · secondOpen.rowCount = 20. Frames evidence-D/A1-first-open.png (blank, "0 versions", while the card badge reads 24) vs A2-second-open-populated.png.
defects.mechanism: Non-immediate watcher on a prop whose initial value is already the trigger value; component created inside the same tick that opens it.
defects.reproduction: Load /#/browse against a same-origin VITE_API_URL server, open any versioned palette's menu → Versions → blank. Escape. Versions again → populated. Scripted: node scratchpad/vhd-probe2.mjs <out>, compare firstOpen/secondOpen.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the local watcher/state machine entirely. Key useVersionHistory on the request identity (slug) and let it expose a discriminated state {status:'idle'|'loading'|'ready'|'error', versions, total, error}; the drawer renders a switch. Loading is then driven by the slug appearing, not by an open-transition the host cannot guarantee.

defects.defect: Revert is `opacity: 0` at rest with `pointer-events: auto`, revealed ONLY by `group-hover`, which Tailwind compiles inside `@media (hover: hover)` — so on every touch device the rule does not exist and the destructive button is permanently invisible yet tappable.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:75-84 `class="... opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"`. Verbatim from node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/styles/components.css: `@media (hover:hover){.group-hover\:opacity-100:is(:where(.group):hover *){opacity:1}}` — the only rule in the cascade that raises this element's opacity. Measured at rest (probe2.json secondOpen.revertButtons): {w:90, h:36, opacity:"0", pointerEvents:"auto"}.
defects.mechanism: Hover-gated reveal of a destructive control; the reveal rule is media-gated out of existence on coarse pointers.
defects.reproduction: grep the shipped CSS for `group-hover\:opacity-100` — it is inside @media (hover:hover); no other rule sets non-zero opacity. (Caveat stated in report: Playwright's mobile arms emulate viewport, not the hover media feature, so the touch consequence is CONFIRMED-BY-CSS, not from a driven touch device.)
defects.proposedCure: Promote Revert out of hover into the row as a persistent, named `text-small` control — the 44px invisible band is layout the design already pays for. Identical on touch and pointer. PROPORTION-AUDIT PR-07 names this species (`Hover-only/unlabeled controls` → ADD-AFFORDANCE/REMOVE).

defects.defect: A keyboard-focused Revert is invisible: it is the first Tab stop inside the modal and computes `opacity: 0`, which also erases the focus ring glass-ui's Button root already paints.
defects.evidence: evidence-D/probe3.json keyboardFocusOnRevert[0], pointer explicitly parked at (5,890): {tag:"BUTTON", text:"Revert", inDialog:true, opacity:"0", visibility:"visible", rect:{w:90,h:36,top:284}, inViewport:true, boxShadow:"rgba(255,255,255,0.3) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, …"}. probe4 revertClass includes `focus-ring`. The utility `.focus\:opacity-100:focus{opacity:1}` IS generated and shipped in the same components.css — it was simply not used.
defects.mechanism: opacity:0 on the element zeroes its own box-shadow focus indicator; no focus/focus-visible variant accompanies the group-hover variant.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-probe3.mjs <out> — open drawer twice, page.mouse.move(5,890), press Tab, read activeElement computed opacity. WCAG 2.4.7 (A) and 2.4.11 (AA) both fail.
defects.proposedCure: Same as D-02 — a persistent visible control retires the whole class. If a reveal is kept at all it must carry focus-visible:opacity-100, but subtraction precedes explanation (PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.6).

defects.defect: Revert is destructive and irreversible and fires on one activation with zero confirmation.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:80 `@click="$emit('revert', version.hash)"` → BrowsePane.vue:279 `pm.versions.revert(...)`. Measured: evidence-D/probe3.json revertBehaviour.stateAfter.confirmationDialogs = 0; requestsAfterRevert = ["POST /palettes/census-palette/revert"].
defects.mechanism: Commit with no select→confirm step, contra VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §5 (select → tune → commit) and §7 ("dangerous confirmation").
defects.reproduction: probe3.json revertBehaviour — one click on the (invisible) Revert issues the POST immediately; document.querySelectorAll('[role="alertdialog"]').length === 0.
defects.proposedCure: One glass-ui AlertDialog confirmation step naming the target version's ordinal and date, then refetch-or-close on success.

defects.defect: After a revert the version list is never refetched, so the panel renders a history that cannot exist: `v24` sits ABOVE `v23 (current)`, the revert commit is absent, and the description count is stale.
defects.evidence: evidence-D/probe3.json revertBehaviour: requestsAfterRevert = ["POST /palettes/census-palette/revert"] — exactly one request, no GET .../versions follows. stateAfter = {rowCount:20, description:"Census Palette — 24 versions", labels:["v24","v23 (current)","v22","v21"]} while the mocked server returned versionCount 25 and a new currentHash. Frame evidence-D/F2-after-revert.png.
defects.mechanism: The only call sites of loadVersions are the (never-firing) open watch and loadMore; BrowsePane.vue:277-285 reassigns versionPalette (moving the currentHash prop and therefore the ring) but nothing re-reads the list. The `(current)` marker walks backwards through a monotone append-only log.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-probe3.mjs <out> — hover row 1, click Revert, wait 2.2s, read requestsAfterRevert and stateAfter.labels.
defects.proposedCure: Fold into the composable's state machine (D-01 cure): a successful revert invalidates the version query, which refetches or closes the drawer. Never mutate the current-marker without re-reading the log it indexes.

defects.defect: loading ≡ empty ≡ error ≡ first-open: four distinct states render one identical blank panel that asserts "— 0 versions" as fact. There is no empty state and no error state at all.
defects.evidence: probe2.json: firstOpen / empty-desktop-light / C1-error / C2-slow-loading all → rowCount 0, bodyText "Version HistoryCensus Palette — 0 versionsClose". C1-error-console: ["Failed to load resource: 500", "Failed to load versions: ApiProblem: Internal Server Error"]. useVersionHistory.ts:56-62 swallows the failure into console.warn and returns undefined; VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:141 `if (!page) return` leaves total at 0 while `finally` clears loading. VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:11 publishes `{{ total }} version{{...}}` before total is known.
defects.mechanism: No discriminated state; absence of data is rendered identically regardless of cause.
defects.reproduction: probe2.json C1-error (route fulfilled 500) vs empty-desktop-light (data:[], total:0) — byte-identical bodyText.
defects.proposedCure: Use demo/shared/ui/EmptyState.vue, which the host BrowsePane already imports and whose own docstring states the law: "TWO species, never conflated (SYNTHESIS §2.4 — loading ≠ empty, error ≠ empty)". error variant carries role=alert + detail + Retry slot; empty variant carries role=status. Loading uses the route's PaletteCardSkeleton variant="developing" grammar, not a bare spinner. Never publish total until known.

defects.defect: Three of the four per-instance style overrides in this file are inert dead CSS that have never once applied: `w-[380px]`, `sm:max-w-[420px]` and `h-7`. glass-ui ships placement/button CSS UNLAYERED, which outranks every Tailwind `@layer utilities` rule regardless of specificity.
defects.evidence: probe3.json widthCascade — declared 380px/420px, measured computed {width:"384px", maxWidth:"384px"}; utilityExists (synthetic probe div, same document) = {w380:"380px", smMax420:"420px"} so the utilities DO generate. Winning rules: {layer:"(unlayered)", sel:':where([data-slot="dialog-content"][data-placement="right"])', css:"…width:75%;"} and {layer:"(unlayered)", …, css:"max-width:24rem;"}. layerOrder = [properties, theme, base, components, utilities, …]. probe4: revertHeight "36px" vs h7ProbeHeight "28px", heightRules = [{layer:"utilities", sel:".h-7", h:"calc(var(--spacing)*7)"}]. Source: node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/components/dialog/placement.css.
defects.mechanism: CSS cascade layers: an unlayered declaration beats every layered one, so `:where()` at specificity 0,0,0 defeats `.w-\[380px\]` at 0,1,0.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-probe3.mjs <out> → widthCascade; node scratchpad/vhd-probe4.mjs → heightRules. Every frame ever shipped is the producer default (75% mobile / 24rem desktop), not the designed 380–420px sheet — live since f2c8f565.
defects.proposedCure: Delete all three (edict 2: no dead paths). If a 380–420px drawer is genuinely wanted it is a `size` axis authored in glass-ui (edicts 4+5). Relay to the glass-ui BH inbox: placement CSS shipped unlayered makes EVERY consumer box-model override silently inert — this is why edict 5 is a correctness law here, not a preference.

defects.defect: Under forced colors every colour swatch renders black — the entire colour payload of a colour-palette version history dies — and the measured current-row vs other-row delta is ZERO on every surface property.
defects.evidence: probe3.json forcedColors (Chromium, forcedColors:"active", dark): swatch = {bg:"rgb(0,0,0)", borderColor:"rgb(255,255,255)", forcedColorAdjust:"auto"} while swatchInline = "background-color: rgb(225, 29, 72);". current = other = {bg:"rgb(0,0,0)", borderColor:"rgb(255,255,255)", boxShadow:"none", color:"rgb(255,255,255)"}; currentBar bg "rgb(0,0,0)" on sheetBg "rgb(0,0,0)".
defects.mechanism: forced-color-adjust left at auto on colour specimens; ring-2 is a box-shadow, which forced colors strips, and the -left-px bar collapses to the sheet colour.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-probe3.mjs <out> → forcedColors + frame evidence-D/F4-forced-colors.png. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.2 ("nonzero selected-state delta in monochrome and forced colors") and §4.1.
defects.proposedCure: Colour specimens are the textbook sanctioned `forced-color-adjust: none` case — set it on the WatercolorDot faces. Carry the current-state on a forced-colors-surviving property (border-style/width or a text marker), not a box-shadow ring. Retire two of the three redundant current markers per PR-06/PR-05 while doing so.

defects.defect: 23 of 24 rows reserve a 44.0px invisible band (34% of row height) for the opacity-0 Revert button; the current row does not, so the list carries two unexplained rhythms.
defects.evidence: probe3.json typeCensus.rowHeights = [85.5, 129.5, 129.5, 129.5, 129.5, 129.5] — current row 85.5px, every other row 129.5px, delta exactly 44.0px = h-9 (36) + mt-2 (8). Visible as a void at the bottom of every non-current row in evidence-D/B1-desktop-dark.png and A2-second-open-populated.png.
defects.mechanism: opacity:0 rather than absence keeps the button in flow — PROPORTION-AUDIT PR-01's own "unconditional reservation" mechanism reappearing.
defects.reproduction: probe3.json typeCensus.rowHeights. Violates PROPORTION-AUDIT §5.3 (reserve only on the axis where collision exists) and §5.5 (operable ornaments without names are forbidden).
defects.proposedCure: Spend the band: a persistent named control (D-02 cure) makes the reservation honest and equalises the rhythm.

defects.defect: Version identity is the positional expression `total - i` rather than the record's own server ordinal `depth`, so every label goes wrong the moment `total` moves — as it does after this drawer's own Revert.
defects.evidence: VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:37 `v{{ total - i }}`; demo/palettes/types.ts:76 `depth: number` is never read. Measured consequence in probe3.json revertBehaviour.stateAfter.labels = ["v24","v23 (current)","v22","v21"] against a server holding 25 versions. Paging offset uses versions.value.length (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:154), so an append between pages shifts the window (duplicate :key hash or a skipped record) — labelled a HYPOTHESIS in the report; the offset arithmetic at :140,154 is the mechanism.
defects.mechanism: Display identity derived from a mutable count and a paging index instead of the record's own ordinal.
defects.reproduction: probe3.json revertBehaviour.stateAfter.labels. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §6.1 "palette/release order | preserve explicit ordinal identity".
defects.proposedCure: Render `depth` (or a server-supplied version number). A label recomputed from a cursor is not an identity.

defects.defect: Three semantic roles — ordinal, provenance, palette identity — collapse onto one identical 11px Plus Jakarta Sans setting; `text-micro` is not in VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4's closed matrix at all; and the invisible button's label is 31% LARGER than the data it acts on.
defects.evidence: probe3.json typeCensus: versionLabel `v24 (current)` 11px/13.75px Plus Jakarta Sans 500; timestamp `Mar 26 at 12:30 AM` 11px Plus Jakarta Sans 400 with fontVariantNumeric tabular-nums; nameLine `Census Palette` 11px Plus Jakarta Sans 400. revertBtn 14.384px, loadMore 14.384px. §4 assigns value/provenance → text-mono-small (Fira Code) and palette identity → --type-subheading (Fraunces); the closed matrix contains no --type-micro. dateFormat.ts:1-13 emits no year; timeSemantics = 0.
defects.mechanism: One utility (`text-micro`) used for four distinct jobs; only weight and colour differentiate, contra §4.1 ("states are never colour-only").
defects.reproduction: probe3.json typeCensus table. `tabular-nums` on a humanist face is the tell — the author wanted the mono register and reached for a numeric feature instead of the assigned family.
defects.proposedCure: Speak the matrix: ordinal + timestamp + hash in Fira Code text-mono-small; row name in Fraunces --type-subheading; controls at text-small. Emit <time datetime> with a year. Retire text-micro from this panel.

defects.defect: The side sheet does not mirror in RTL — measured x = 1056 in both directions while the entire page mirrors around it — and five further direction defects render in one frame.
defects.evidence: probe2.json B5-rtl-desktop.contentRect.x = 1056, identical to desktop-light. Frame evidence-D/B5-rtl-desktop.png shows: (1) header left-aligned over a right-aligned body — glass-ui DialogHeader compiles to "flex flex-col gap-y-1.5 text-center sm:text-left", a physical keyword; (2) `+6` renders `6+`; (3) `Forked from cccccccc...` renders `...Forked from cccccccc`; (4) the 85-char name truncates from the wrong end (LTR keeps the head, RTL keeps the tail); (5) the current-marker bar stays physically left (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:31 `absolute -left-px`).
defects.mechanism: placement="right" is a physical axis with no logical arm in placement.css; neutral characters and hashes are not LTR-isolated; DialogHeader's text-left is physical.
defects.reproduction: node scratchpad/vhd-probe2.mjs <out> with dir=rtl init script → B5 arm + frame. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §6.1 (chrome follows logical direction; strings/hex/IDs render LTR-isolated).
defects.proposedCure: Logical placement (inline-start/inline-end) on the producer; LTR-isolated mono spans for hash/count tokens; logical -inline-start for the marker. The header's physical text-left is a producer defect for the BH relay.

defects.defect: Below 40rem the header is centre-aligned over a left-aligned body, the row header's justify-between wraps into rag, and the type/container relationship inverts — text is 1.34x larger relative to its container at 320px than at 1440px.
defects.evidence: Frame evidence-D/B4-narrow-320-light.png at 320x568: title and description centred (DialogHeader `text-center sm:text-left`), rows left-aligned; `v24 / (current)` and `Mar 26 at 12:30 / AM` wrap and are pushed apart by justify-between; description breaks as "Census Palette — 24" / "versions". Measured contentRect {x:80, w:240} — a 75% sheet leaving an 80px unusable sliver. Control font-size 12.032px@320 / 12.179px@390 / 14.384px@1440 against panel widths 240/292.5/384 → type at 84% while container at 62%.
defects.mechanism: Panel scales with viewport; contents do not. Producer's `width: 75%` mobile arm was never considered by the consumer.
defects.reproduction: probe2.json B4-narrow-320-light + B2 + secondOpen loadMore.fontSize. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §3.7 ("container-scaled … no desktop-tight/mobile-airy fork") and §3.6.
defects.proposedCure: Decide what this is on a phone: a bottom-sheet/full-screen surface below 40rem, or the centred dialog its sibling FlagReportDialog.vue:3 already uses correctly at the same width. Container-scale the body type.

defects.defect: The producer's `scroll` axis is unused and a second scroll container is hand-rolled inside the producer's flex region; colour swatches are a hand-rolled second species instead of WatercolorDot, unnamed and not aria-hidden; and hover replaces the OPAQUE bg-well with a 50%-alpha accent.
defects.evidence: probe.json dataScroll = null (DialogContent publishes a `scroll` prop that stamps data-scroll and drives the region's max-block-size/overflow-y); VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:15 hand-rolls `flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin` inside it, plus a redundant `flex flex-col` on the content root (:3). probe2.json swatchA11y = {ariaHidden:null, role:null, title:null, tag:"DIV", inlineStyle:"background-color: rgb(225,29,72);"}; swatchBorder.borderColor rgb(251,250,248) (--background) on a well measured oklab(0.913299 0.005463 0.013024) — a halo brighter than its surface. Hover: rowInfo bg goes oklab(0.913299 …) → oklab(0.871139 0.007229 0.023625 / 0.5).
defects.mechanism: Reaching past the design system for behaviour and species it already provides; hover:bg-accent/50 replaces an opaque token with a translucent one.
defects.reproduction: probe.json dataScroll/scrollCandidateInfo; probe2.json D1-hover.rowInfo[1].bg vs secondOpen.rowInfo[1].bg. Violates edicts 4/5, VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §2 tier 5 ("the only ornamental colour-bearing species") and §4.2, and demo/DESIGN.md:98's own well law ("an OPAQUE tone-step … nothing live sits behind") — which cites this component by name while the host sheet measures 70.5% alpha with page copy legible through it (frames A2/B1).
defects.proposedCure: Pass the producer's `scroll` prop; delete the nested scroller and the redundant flex. Use WatercolorDot with a named accessible list. Fix the swatch separator token to the actual parent surface. Keep the hover well opaque.

defects.defect: No list semantics, no <time>, no live region, no status role anywhere; useVersionHistory exports 7 members with zero consumers while the drawer re-implements 5 of them locally; the drawer injects a 32-member facade to reach one function; and a source comment documents a condition the code does not implement.
defects.evidence: probe2.json listSemantics = {ul:0, li:0, roleList:0}, timeSemantics = 0, liveRegions = 0, headings = ["H2:Version History"] — 24 ordered historical records as bare divs. grep across demo/: only pm.versions.fetchVersions (VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:140), .revert (BrowsePane.vue:279), .fork (useDialogBrowseActions.ts:55) are consumed; versions/total/loading/paletteSlug/loadVersions/loadMore/reset have none, while VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:133-155 re-declares five of them. VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:132 injects BROWSE_PORT_KEY (32 members, usePalettePorts.ts:157-192; DEFECT-LEDGER.md:23386 already records this file as a one-slice consumer). VersionHistoryDrawer.vue:45 comments "Name (if different from current)" while :46-48 renders it unconditionally — measured bodyText repeats "Census Palette" on every row under a description that already states it.
defects.mechanism: Duplicated state ownership plus god-facade injection plus stale documentation.
defects.reproduction: grep -rn 'pm.versions.' demo/ → 3 hits; probe2.json listSemantics/timeSemantics/liveRegions.
defects.proposedCure: An <ol>/<li> of version records with depth as the ordinal, <time datetime>, one role=status for load/count/result. Make useVersionHistory actually own the state its own docstring claims (folds into D-01's cure) and inject only the slice this component needs. Delete the lying comment or implement its condition.

result.strongestDefect: D-02/D-03 — the Revert button. It is opacity:0 with pointer-events:auto; its only reveal is a group-hover rule compiled inside `@media (hover: hover)`, so on every touch device it is invisible forever and still tappable. With the pointer parked off-panel it is the FIRST Tab stop inside the modal, measured at opacity "0", and its own focus ring (glass-ui's `focus-ring` on the Button root) is erased by that same opacity. It fires an irreversible POST /revert on one activation with confirmationDialogs = 0. And after it fires (D-05) the panel shows `v24` sitting above `v23 (current)` — a history that cannot exist. An invisible, unconfirmed, keyboard-reachable, touch-tappable destructive control that leaves the UI lying about what it did is not a proportion complaint; it is a shipping hazard.
result.negativeProof: Verdict is DEFECTIVE, but the report records what is genuinely sound so the register is not inflated: (1) MOTION IS PROPERLY TOKENIZED — measured `transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)` from the producer's --default-transition-duration/--default-transition-timing-function, correctly stepping to 0.1s under prefers-reduced-motion (probe2.json B6-reduced-motion vs secondOpen); no ad-hoc durations, only opacity and background-color are animated (no layout-forcing property), no keyframes deleted — edict 6 satisfied. (2) THE HOVER SURFACE DELTA IS REAL, not decorative-only: oklab(0.913299 0.005463 0.013024) → oklab(0.871139 0.007229 0.023625 / 0.5); I measured before claiming it was imperceptible, and retracted that claim. (3) THE +N OVERFLOW CHIP IS THE CODEBASE'S GOOD PRECEDENT AND IT WORKS — measured swatchRows [5,8,1,5,…] with plusChips ["+6"] for a 14-colour version, capped at 8 with an honest remainder (SCALABILITY-AUDIT.md:138 calls this row "the good precedent"). (4) PAGINATION TERMINATES CORRECTLY — after Load older versions, rowCount 24, labels [v24…v1], loadMore null; the button retires exactly when the cursor exhausts. (5) verbatimModuleSyntax is clean (:116 `import type { PaletteVersion }`). (6) Vue 3.5 idioms are correct — reactive props destructure at :118; no defineModel round-trip so no shallowRef is owed; no template refs so no useTemplateRef is owed. (7) The dialog title correctly joins the display voice — measured Fraunces, weight 500 — i.e. the one thing the existing e2e checks is the one thing that passes. (8) role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are wired by the producer and present.

defects.defect: The `admin` authorization concept has two homes — a dead router `meta.admin` flag and 21 scattered `if (!token) return` early-returns — and neither owns the 'unauthorized' render state, so an unauthenticated visitor is served a false clean moderation queue.
defects.evidence: demo/color-picker/router/index.ts:31-35 declares `meta: { admin: true }` on 5 routes; `grep -rn "meta.admin|beforeEach" demo/ --include="*.ts" --include="*.vue"` returns NO MATCHES (the only other `meta` uses in demo/ are `import.meta.env`). `grep -rn "if (!token) return" demo/ --include="*.ts" | wc -l` → 21 (useAdminUsers 10, useColorNameQueue 5, useAdminFlagged 3, useAdminTags 2, useAdminAudit 1). demo/palettes/useAdminFlagged.ts:59-63 returns before `loading.value = true` and before any fetch, leaving loading=false / loadError=null / items=[]. Visual proof: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/admin-flagged.png — dock reads 'Login', pane reads '0 flagged' / '· NOTHING FLAGGED ·' / 'No flagged palettes.' Harness seeds only `vueuse-color-scheme` (capture.mjs:71).
defects.mechanism: unowned-state / duplicated-authority — one concept declared in two places, enforced in neither, with the resulting fourth state (unauthorized) modelled nowhere in the lattice
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/admin/flagged with no `palette-admin-token` in localStorage (or read the already-captured admin-flagged.png in all four Safari matrices). The panel renders the true-empty moderation plate. Inverse confirmed live: with a token present, `/unreachable/.test(document.body.innerText)` === true and `/nothing flagged/` === false — so the two states ARE distinguishable and the code picks the wrong one only when unauthenticated.
defects.proposedCure: One owner for `admin`: a `router.beforeEach` reading `meta.admin` against `useAdminAuth().isAuthenticated`, redirecting so the panel is never mounted unauthorized. Then delete all 21 `if (!token) return` guards — a token becomes the composables' precondition. If an unauthorized render is ever wanted, it becomes an explicit fourth `EmptyState variant="unauthorized"` branch, never a silent fallthrough.

defects.defect: `demo/ui/` is a 19-directory alias layer that owns nothing — 18 of 19 barrels are single-line re-exports of the glass-ui ROOT barrel, when glass-ui 7.0.0 publishes a fine-grained subpath for every one of them. It is a back-compat shim for the retired shadcn import path and it creates a live dual path.
defects.evidence: AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:139-140 imports Button/Badge via `../../../ui/button`, `../../../ui/badge`. demo/ui/button/index.ts is exactly `export { Button } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`; demo/ui/badge/index.ts likewise. node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/package.json#exports declares `./button`, `./badge`, `./card`, `./skeleton`, `./dialog`, `./tabs`, `./select` … (70+ entries). Dual path measured across demo/: 41 shim sites (button/badge/card) vs 37 bare-root sites vs 82 direct-subpath sites; `Dialog` reached both ways (shim + `@mkbabb/glass-ui/dialog` ×2); AdminPane.vue:87 mixes both in one script block. Dist fan-out: `grep -oE 'from *"\./[^"]+"' glass-ui.js | sort -u | wc -l` → 43 chunks / 168,303 B, vs button.js = 71 B / 1 chunk, badge.js = 92 B / 1 chunk. Live dev server resource timing: `@mkbabb_glass-ui.js` = 234,309 B, the largest glass-ui module loaded.
defects.mechanism: legacy alias layer / dual path — a redirect-only module tier standing between consumers and the design system's real public surface
defects.reproduction: `for f in demo/ui/*/index.ts; do cat $f; done` — 18 one-line root re-exports. Then `node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('./node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/package.json').exports))"` shows the subpath for each. Bundle claim is bounded honestly: glass-ui declares `sideEffects: ["*.css"]` and `grep -c '\.css"' dist/glass-ui.js` → 0, so Rollup CAN tree-shake the root barrel in production — the 234 KB is a measured dev-server cost, not a proven production regression.
defects.proposedCure: Delete `demo/ui/` entirely and rewrite the 41 import sites to name the glass-ui subpath they actually want (`@mkbabb/glass-ui/button`, `/badge`, …). The layer holds zero logic, zero variants, zero tokens — every directory in it is a redirect. One whole tier of the lattice disappears with nothing lost.

defects.defect: The `usePaletteManager` 'god facade dissolution' produced a LARGER file and two god-sized ports, and its own stated invariant ('no consumer injects a member outside the port it named') is falsified — `flagged` is provided on two ports and injected through both.
defects.evidence: usePalettePorts.ts:22-31 claims dissolution of a '153 L, ONE cross-everything injected blob' into 'FIVE narrow, feature-owned ports'. `wc -l demo/palettes/usePalettePorts.ts` → 275. Measured port sizes by parsing the five object literals: sessionPort 7, libraryPort 15, browsePort 32, adminPort 34, colorTargetPort 5. AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:149-150 injects the 34-member adminPort and consumes exactly 1 member (`flagged`). Measured cross-port overlap: session∩browse = {ensureSession, ensureUser, isAdminAuthenticated, userSlug}; library∩browse = {expandedId, onEditColor, searchQuery, toggleExpand}; library∩admin = {expandedId, searchQuery, toggleExpand}; browse∩admin = {expandedId, flagged, onFeaturePalette, searchQuery, toggleExpand}. Both reaches live: AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:149-150 via ADMIN_PORT_KEY; BrowsePane.vue:202,298 `pm.flagged.report(...)` via BROWSE_PORT_KEY.
defects.mechanism: god module reconstituted as an overlapping covering rather than a partition — five views onto one blob, plus a dual injection path for one concept
defects.reproduction: Run the port-literal parse over demo/palettes/usePalettePorts.ts (member counts + pairwise set intersections as above), then `grep -rn '\.flagged' demo/ --include="*.vue" --include="*.ts"` → BrowsePane.vue:298 (BROWSE_PORT_KEY) and AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:150 (ADMIN_PORT_KEY), same singleton constructed once at usePalettePorts.ts:75.
defects.proposedCure: Make the ports a PARTITION, not a covering. Straddling members (`searchQuery`, `expandedId`, `toggleExpand`, `isAdminAuthenticated`, `userSlug`) move to their own narrow ports (`UI_STATE_PORT`, `SESSION_PORT`) injected alongside, never copied into siblings. Remove `flagged` from `browsePort` entirely (see L-5), killing the dual injection path.

defects.defect: `useAdminFlagged` owns two unrelated concepts with two different audiences and two different auth postures — the token-gated admin moderation queue AND the unauthenticated user-facing flag report — in one shared singleton instance.

defects.reproduction: Read demo/palettes/useAdminFlagged.ts:1-11 (the admission) and :120-122 (the unauthenticated method) alongside :59-61, :82-83, :94-95 (the three `getToken(); if (!token) return` gates). defects.defect: Offset-pagination arithmetic is reimplemented byte-for-byte in two sibling composables, despite a generic wire type and an established extraction idiom already living in the same directory.
defects.evidence: useAdminFlagged.ts:49-57,105-118 and useAdminAudit.ts:36-46,73-88 are identical modulo ref names and the fetch call: `const page = ref(1); const pageSize = 20; const pageCount = computed(() => Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total.value / pageSize))); const hasNext = computed(() => page.value < pageCount.value); const hasPrev = computed(() => page.value > 1);` plus identical nextPage/prevPage. Both re-declare the same 7 members in their `UseAdmin*` interface and re-list them in the return. demo/palettes/types.ts already ships `PaginatedResponse<T> { data: T[]; total: number; limit: number; offset: number }`; demo/palettes/useFilteredList.ts is a 13-line generic proving the extraction idiom is established in this exact directory.
defects.mechanism: duplicated concept — two homes for one algorithm, with the generalization already available and unused
defects.reproduction: `diff <(sed -n '30,60p' demo/palettes/useAdminAudit.ts) <(sed -n '44,75p' demo/palettes/useAdminFlagged.ts)` — the diff is confined to identifier names and the endpoint call; the pagination lines are identical.
defects.proposedCure: One `useOffsetPagination<T>(fetcher: (limit, offset) => Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>>)` returning `{ items, total, page, pageCount, hasNext, hasPrev, loading, loadError, load, next, prev }`. useAdminFlagged and useAdminAudit each shrink to their genuinely distinct part — the endpoint and the mutations. ~60 duplicated lines die.

defects.defect: A failed moderation command is completely invisible: approve/reject/delete swallow every error to console.warn. The panel designed error≠empty for LOADS (W5-5/F-2) and designed nothing at all for MUTATIONS — the only thing a moderator actually does here.

The two Retry buttons at AdminNamesPanel.vue:37 and :87 re-run loads only (AdminPane.vue:56-57 → loadColorQueue/loadApprovedColors). vue-sonner was removed repo-wide, so there is no toast path either. Contrast the care at AdminNamesPanel.vue:30-41 (full error plate + detail + Retry for reads).
defects.mechanism: M-1 designed for reads, not for writes — the state model is 'two arrays'; a command has no representation before, during or after it runs
defects.reproduction: Sign in as admin on /#/admin/names with >=1 pending item; make the API return 500 for POST /colors/:id/approve; click Approve. The row does not move, no error appears, nothing is announced; only a console.warn fires.
defects.proposedCure: Make the row the state owner: give AdminListItem a `state` slot fed by a per-item operation record (idle | inflight | failed) so an in-flight row dims and disables its own actions and a failed row keeps its place carrying the machine message and a real per-row Retry. The EmptyState variant="error" register already exists — this is the same species one altitude lower, not a new mechanism.

result.strongestDefect: D-1 — an unauthenticated moderation queue costumes as a CLEAR queue. `useAdminFlagged.ts:59-61` early-returns on a null admin token, leaving (loading=false, loadError=null, items=[]), which the panel's v-if chain resolves to the TRUE-EMPTY plate "· nothing flagged · / No flagged palettes." Cross-confirmed live in one session — /#/admin/names said "The proposal queue is unreachable." while /#/admin/flagged said "0 flagged / No flagged palettes." at the same instant. This is the exact defect the panel's own comment (line 20) claims W5-5/F-2 cured; F-2 was closed against loadError and never against no-authority, which is the commoner and more dangerous arm.
result.negativeProof: n/a — verdict is DEFECTIVE. (Proven-negative sub-claims are recorded in report §4: verbatimModuleSyntax has nothing to violate — no type-only imports at :137-146; no god module — 153 lines, one job; no invented shared/ dir or wrapper — EmptyState/AdminListSkeleton/PaginationBar all pre-existing; edict 6 intact — no animation was deleted; Vue 3.5 idioms N/A — no props, no template refs; the W5-a11y pass held — every icon-only button carries aria-label with aria-hidden glyphs, REPORT.json records namelessButtons:0 on this route in all four matrices and none of the 4 small-tap-target rows belong to this component.)

defects.defect: Unauthenticated state renders as a clear moderation queue — the state taxonomy has three species (loading/error/empty) for a domain with four (loading/unauthorized/error/empty).
defects.evidence: demo/palettes/useAdminFlagged.ts:59-61 `const token = getToken(); if (!token) return;` leaves (loading=false, loadError=null, items=[]); AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:16/22/37 v-if chain resolves that triple to the TRUE-EMPTY plate at :37-41. Shipped captures: docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-desktop-light/admin-flagged.png (dock shows signed-out `Login`; card shows `0 flagged` + `No flagged palettes.`), identical in the other 3 matrices. Live cross-check 2026-07-29T02:52Z on localhost:9000: /#/admin/names → "The proposal queue is unreachable." while /#/admin/flagged → "0 flagged / · nothing flagged · / No flagged palettes."
defects.mechanism: F-alpha — the state taxonomy is short a species; authority is treated as a per-list concern instead of a route property
defects.reproduction: Open http://localhost:9000/#/admin/flagged with no `palette-admin-token` in localStorage. Panel asserts an empty flag queue without ever calling the endpoint. Also visible in all 4 shipped audit captures.
defects.proposedCure: Authority is a property of the ROUTE, not of each list: AdminPane.vue gates the whole five-route suite on useAdminAuth().isAuthenticated and renders one signed-out article in place of the body. All five panels then assume authority and `if (!token) return` disappears from all five composables. (Related: PALETTE-CONTRACT.md §2 forbids a localStorage auth path in the browser; useAdminAuth.ts:15 uses one.)

defects.defect: Irreversible destructive command with no confirmation, in violation of an explicit binding law.
defects.evidence: AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:93-101 — one click calls flagged.deletePalette(item.paletteSlug) → DELETE /admin/palettes/:slug (useAdminFlagged.ts:93-103). No dialog/undo/restore. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §7: Admin is "a five-route review suite … using one review-row anatomy, query/pagination/state grammar, **dangerous confirmation** and responsive disclosure." PROPORTION-AUDIT.md PR-11: "One review anatomy with authority/state/confirmation." The panel's comment at :86-89 spends four lines on the button's COLOUR and zero on its danger.
defects.mechanism: F-delta — danger is styled, not designed
defects.reproduction: With an admin token, click the trash glyph on any flagged row: another user's palette is deleted on first pointer-down with no confirmation step.
defects.proposedCure: One suite-level destructive-confirmation composition (glass-ui AlertDialog) naming scope (palette, owner, flag count) and effect, owned by the shared review-row anatomy — one owner, five sites — not a per-panel confirm.

defects.defect: The actor is designed out: `Flag.reporterSlug` is on the wire and in the type but never rendered, so brigading and report-abuse are structurally invisible.

defects.defect: loading / error / populated are not mutually exclusive — the item v-for sits outside the v-if chain, so skeletons render above stale rows during pagination and the 'unreachable' error plate renders above a still-interactive stale queue.

defects.proposedCure: One derived status union ("loading"|"unauthorized"|"error"|"empty"|"ready") driving a single v-if/v-else-if/v-else chain so the panel can only ever be in one state.

defects.defect: No command has an in-flight, failed, or succeeded state — failures are swallowed to console.warn — while glass-ui 7's Button ships a documented `loading` prop that is used zero times.

defects.proposedCure: Per-entity operation state on the row (glass-ui `loading` on the acting Button + a durable failure annotation on the entity), not a transient toast and not a console.warn.

defects.defect: `variant` is a dead prop in glass-ui 7 — the panel's entire deliberately-asymmetric action hierarchy is not rendered; both buttons resolve to the same default emphasis.
defects.evidence: AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:10,:29,:90 `variant="outline"`, :93 `variant="ghost"`. glass-ui 7.0.0 (package.json version 7.0.0); dist/index.d.ts:5 `export * from "./components/button"`; dist/components/button/Button.vue.d.ts ButtonProps = { emphasis, tone, size, iconOnly, loading, type, disabled, class } — no `variant`. `grep -c variant dist/button-Bu9F4uU6.js` → 0. `grep -roh "\[variant=[^]]*\]" dist/styles/` → no output (no attribute selector). demo/ui/button/index.ts is a bare re-export. defects.mechanism: F-gamma — Glass-7 adoption residue: legacy prop names surviving a major with no typecheck failure (Vue accepts fallthrough attributes). Also an edict-2 (no legacy) violation.
defects.reproduction: Inspect any Button in this panel in the DOM: `variant="outline"` appears as a literal attribute selecting no CSS; the recipe keys off data-emphasis. The comment at :86-89 claims a weighted pair; both render at the default emphasis.
defects.proposedCure: Sweep every call site to `emphasis="secondary"|"quiet"` + `tone="destructive"` and delete the `variant` spelling entirely — no alias, no compat shim (edict 2).

defects.defect: Per-instance geometry override loses to the producer root: every control renders 28 × 36 (and ≈27 × 50 on mobile) instead of the square icon button the design intends — while glass-ui ships the exact xs rung and an `iconOnly` prop.

Button.vue.d.ts:12-13 `/** Square geometry for an accessibly named icon command. */ iconOnly?: boolean;`. Mobile capture shots/safari-mobile-light/admin-flagged.png: the button box measures ≈82 × 150 device px at DPR 3 = ≈27 × 50 CSS px. Sites: AdminFlaggedPanel.vue:10, :29, :90, :93 (`class="h-7 px-2"`).

defects.defect: The toolbar is proportioned by remainder: 343px of void (74% of the strip) between the count and the only control that changes it — and the sibling panel does it the opposite way.

defects.defect: Three boundary species stacked on one row — a full box rule plus an intra-row rule in a second mint — in a register PROPORTION-AUDIT PR-05 explicitly zeroed.

defects.defect: Badges are per-instance-overridden instead of using the producer `size` rung, so every pill is md-padded around caption-sized type.

defects.defect: Emphasis is inverted: a saturated resting-red pill on the non-actionable count, one flat plate for every triage reason — contradicting the panel's own stated F-8 doctrine four lines above.

defects.defect: Forced colors erases the palette specimen and the destructive semantics — the swatch strip is inline background-color only, and the delete command's meaning is hover-only colour.
